product: Petverse: a cute 3D on-chain pet game on Robinhood Chain where players raise, battle and evolve pets and earn a share of a real ETH prize pot.

units.title: Tracer: one sponsored action from login to screen on 46630
units.description: Delivers the thinnest working path: the Next app logs in with Privy, gets an EIP-7702 smart account on 46630 through the GameWallet port, sends one gas-sponsored call to a minimal tracer contract, the worker indexes its event into the dev schema, and the page shows the row; it adds the first Prisma model and migration with a minimal DB_SCHEMA in db.ts, the Ignition module and Blockscout chain entry that deploy and verify the tracer contract, and the generated chain module that carries its address into src/.
notes: hitl steps: owner creates the dev schema in Supabase; owner creates the Privy app (email + Google + external wallet), the Alchemy app and one Gas Manager policy allow-listing the tracer contract; owner funds the deployer with test ETH; owner enters every secret in the Hardhat keystore and local env; owner OKs the tracer contract deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md).
High risk: outside check = the owner repeats the login and tracer action on their own phone browser and confirms the sponsored tx on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: With app and worker running locally, a fresh email login presses the tracer button and within a minute the page shows the indexed row with the call's tx hash, and the tx on 46630 shows the paymaster paid the gas.

units.title: Do EIP-7702 and the ERC-4337 fallback both work on 46630 with one Gas Manager policy and a custom-rules webhook?
units.description: Answers, for the GameWallet port and epic-store-pass's cap webhook, whether an external wallet that refuses 7702 gets a working 4337 smart account on 46630, whether both modes are sponsored by the same policy, and whether the Gas Manager calls a custom-rules webhook with the sender and calldata the AD-7 cap needs, captured on a Vercel preview of the tracer app.
notes: hitl steps: the owner deploys a Vercel preview of the tracer branch for the webhook capture, points the policy's custom rules at it, and approves the recorded answer.
High risk: outside check = the owner confirms both sponsored txs on the explorer and approves the recorded answer.

acceptance.clause: A write-up in epic-platform/ shows one sponsored call in each mode on 46630 with tx hashes, the webhook payload captured, and the answer recorded as a dated decision in epic-platform.md Notes.

units.title: Can a 2-of-3 Safe propose, cancel and execute through a 1-hour TimelockController on 46630, with the Protocol Kit / CLI fallback?
units.description: Answers, for the governance base and every contract epic, whether Safe v1.4.1 canonical contracts and the Safe web UI work on 46630, and if the UI does not, whether Safe Protocol Kit or Safe CLI can propose, sign, cancel and execute a timelocked call there.
notes: hitl steps: the three signers create the 2-of-3 Safe and sign; the owner OKs the test timelock deploy to 46630; Protocol Kit is approved (DECISIONS #32).
High risk: outside check = two of the three signers confirm the executed and cancelled operations on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: A write-up in epic-platform/ shows a test Safe's propose → 1-hour wait → execute and a propose → cancel on 46630 with tx hashes and the path used (UI or Protocol Kit / CLI), recorded as a dated decision in epic-platform.md Notes.

units.title: Does the two-level per-owner pot accumulator keep its balance invariant under every settle path?
units.description: Answers, for epic-pot, whether the AD-4 design (global → bucket by per-owner effective points, bucket → pet by raw points, sleep/wake/bury/claim/Co-Pet settle order) keeps PetCore's ETH balance equal to owed + pending + undistributed + pull balances with no loop over pets, by prototyping it with randomized invariant tests on Hardhat's in-process network.
notes: hitl step: the owner accepts the answer before epic-pot is incepted.

acceptance.clause: The prototype's invariant test runs thousands of random award, steal, sleep, wake (with the day cut), bury, claim, flush and Co-Pet start/leave steps with zero invariant breaks and bounded rounding dust, and the write-up and result are recorded as a dated decision in epic-pot.md Notes.

units.title: Can one worker reveal every commitment on 46630 well inside the 10-minute timeout, and recover after a restart?
units.description: Answers, for the Randomness service and every module that settles on a reveal, the reveal latency on 46630, the backlog behaviour under a burst of requests, the restart and late-reveal behaviour, and the signer's gas cost, by prototyping the AD-6 flow end to end against a test Randomness contract.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs the test contract deploy to 46630 and funds the spike signer key with test ETH.

acceptance.clause: A write-up in epic-platform/ shows p50 and p99 commit-to-reveal times for a burst of at least 100 requests on 46630, a restart mid-burst with no lost reveal, a timed-out request closed as a no-op, and the signer's gas per reveal, recorded as a dated decision in epic-platform.md Notes.

units.title: The gate runs install, typecheck, lint and test for the app and chain/
units.description: Adds the missing typecheck and test scripts to the root app (node:test with Node's TypeScript type stripping), contract tests on Hardhat 3's in-process network with node:test in chain/, one gate script that runs all of them in order, a Hardhat local-node fixture that deploys the Ignition modules for server and worker tests (AD-20), and a CI workflow that runs the same script.
notes: hitl step: the owner sets up the GitHub remote (gh auth login, OWNER-CHECKLIST) so the CI workflow runs; until then the gate runs locally through floor gate.
Known uncertainty: Node's type stripping does not run .tsx or resolve the @/ alias; if tests need either, the owner approves a runner first (not in DECISIONS #24).

acceptance.clause: Running the gate script passes on a clean checkout and fails when a planted failing test is added in either the app or chain/.

units.title: Config and secrets load from one place and never leak
units.description: Adds one typed env loader for app, server and worker that refuses to start when a required value is missing and never prints values, a names-only .env.example, and the Hardhat configVariable / keystore entries for the deployer key and RPC URLs; role keys are added by the entries that create the roles (13, 16).

acceptance.clause: A test starts the loader with one required value missing and gets an error naming the variable but not any value, and a repo search finds no secret value in tracked files.

units.title: Each environment uses its own Postgres schema; tests never touch live data
units.description: Hardens what the tracer started: makes DB_SCHEMA the only source of the schema for the app client, the Prisma CLI and raw SQL; the test setup creates, migrates and drops a test_<runid> schema and refuses any other; seed and reset refuse game; a smoke test queries through the :6543 pooler; a gate check fails when a Prisma model lacks its single-writer comment (AD-12).
notes: hitl steps: the owner creates the game and dev schemas, keeps them out of the Supabase Data API exposed schemas, and turns on RLS, in the Supabase dashboard; no destructive SQL on the live DB (CLAUDE.md).
High risk: outside check = the owner lists the live DB's schemas after a full test run and confirms game is untouched.
units.unknown: The owner confirms the test setup may DROP its own test_<runid> schemas on the live database (AD-13 asks for it; CLAUDE.md needs the owner to say so).

acceptance.clause: The test suite creates and drops its own test_ schema (visible in a before/after schema listing), refuses to run with DB_SCHEMA=game, and the pooler smoke test passes.

units.title: The worker runs on Render with a cursor, idempotent writes and a health route
units.description: Turns the tracer's worker into the always-on Render service: a job loop that later jobs plug into, the indexer reading logs to head minus confirmations with a per-contract IndexerCursor and upserts keyed by (chainId, txHash, logIndex), a rebuild-from-deploy-block command, and a health route reporting indexer lag; on Render it runs on the game schema and indexes the tracer contract, which entry 10 relies on.
notes: hitl steps: the owner creates the Render account and service and enters its env secrets.

acceptance.clause: Killing and restarting the worker mid-sync on Render produces no duplicate or missing indexed rows, and its health route reports a lag under the confirmation depth.

units.title: The app deploys to Vercel with the tracer page working on 46630
units.description: Deploys the Next app to Vercel with preview and production environments, server env secrets in Vercel only, and the tracer page talking to 46630 and the game schema through the hosted worker.
notes: hitl steps: the owner creates the Vercel project, links the repo, enters its env secrets, and adds the Vercel domains to the Privy app's allowed origins.

acceptance.clause: On the Vercel production URL, a fresh email login gets a 7702 smart account, runs the tracer action, and within a minute sees the row the Render worker indexed.

units.title: The server verifies every Privy token and keeps one User per Privy DID
units.description: Verifies the Privy access token (ES256, local verification key) on every API call and keeps a User row keyed by Privy DID holding its on-chain account address (the embedded wallet's own address under 7702, or the 4337 smart-account address from entry 12 for external wallets), with linking a second address only through an explicit link step.
notes: High risk: outside check = the security review in the gate (DECISIONS #2) on the auth path.

acceptance.clause: API tests with a recorded-fixture token pass, a tampered or expired token gets a 401 with the standard error shape, and two logins with one DID leave one User row.

units.title: GameWallet has a local-node test adapter and the external-wallet fallback
units.description: Adds to the GameWallet port a viem wallet-client adapter on the Hardhat local node for tests and, per spike 2's answer, the ERC-4337 smart-account adapter for external wallets that refuse 7702, both behind the same port the tracer uses; the fallback's smart-account address is the identity entry 11 stores.

acceptance.clause: A test sends the tracer call through the test adapter on a local node, and on 46630 an external wallet that refuses 7702 completes the tracer action through the fallback.

units.title: Governance base: UUPS modules behind a Safe-proposed 1-hour timelock, one role per key
units.description: Adds the shared upgradeable base (UUPS, ERC-7201 storage, PAUSER held by the Safe) and the Ignition module that wires a TimelockController (1 hour, Safe as proposer and canceller, open executor) as upgrade admin and parameter setter, with the single-role server keys granted only through it and their configVariable entries, using spike 3's Safe path.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate (DECISIONS #2) on the admin paths, and the testnet drill in entry 15.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a parameter change and an upgrade succeed only after the delay when proposed by the Safe, revert from any other caller, the Safe can pause and cancel but not set a parameter, and each role key can do only its one role.

units.title: The gate runs the OpenZeppelin upgrade-safety validator
units.description: Adds the approved OpenZeppelin upgrade-safety validator (DECISIONS #24, dev only) and runs it in the gate on the contracts' build output against the last deployed layout.

acceptance.clause: The gate fails on a planted storage-layout break in an upgradeable contract and passes once it is removed.

units.title: The governance base is deployed and verified on 46630 and passes a live drill
units.description: Deploys the governance base through Ignition to 46630, verifies every contract on Blockscout, regenerates the chain module, and runs the drill: a Safe-proposed parameter change executes after 1 hour, a direct call reverts, a pause works, a cancel works.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs the deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md); two Safe signers sign the drill transactions.
High risk: outside check = the owner and one other Safe signer confirm the drill on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: The drill's tx hashes on 46630 show propose, 1-hour wait, execute, revert, pause and cancel, and every deployed contract shows verified source on Blockscout.

units.title: Randomness service: commitments, reveals and timeout no-ops for every module
units.description: Delivers the shared AD-6 service from spike 5's answer: the upgradeable Randomness contract behind the timelock, the RANDOMNESS_SIGNER commitment route for logged-in players (EIP-712, bound to player and on-chain nonce), the revealer job in the worker, the RevealLog after reveal, the timeout no-op and a late-reveal alert.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs the Randomness deploy to 46630, funds the RANDOMNESS_SIGNER key with test ETH, enters it in Render's secrets, and the Safe grants the role through the timelock.
High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on signer binding and replay, and the owner confirms one live reveal on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: On a Hardhat local node a test registers, reveals and settles a request through a test module, and a request left 10 minutes unrevealed is closed by a stranger as a no-op; on 46630 the Blockscout-verified service reveals a request within the spike's p99, and a request left unrevealed for 10 minutes is closed by a stranger as a no-op.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Tracer: log in, hatch the free egg on 46630 and see the pet on Home
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through every layer of the epic: upgradeable PetCore and PetNFT on the governance base (PetNFT minted and burned only by PetCore, every other transfer reverts), a hatch call carrying a VOUCHER_SIGNER voucher bound to the Privy DID (the contract caps free eggs per DID hash) and a Randomness commitment whose reveal settles species, coat (an index into `SPECIES_PALETTES[species]` in src/lib/pets.ts) and element (one of fire, water, leaf, spark, stone, drawn at the reveal), the indexer handler that projects PetHatched into a Pet row (first Pet model, indexer as its single writer), and the login → egg → Home screens rendering that pet with the existing EggModel and PetModel.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs the PetCore and PetNFT deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md); the Safe grants GAME_MODULE / VOUCHER_SIGNER wiring through the timelock; the owner creates and funds the VOUCHER_SIGNER key and enters it in the local env and the host secret store; the owner adds PetCore to the Gas Manager policy allow-list.
High risk: outside check = the owner repeats the login and hatch on their own phone browser and confirms the hatch and reveal transactions on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: With app and worker running locally against 46630, a fresh email login taps the egg and Home shows the pet whose species and coat match the PetHatched event and the indexed Pet row, and a second free-egg request for the same login is refused.

units.title: PetCore life cycle: sleep, wake loss, death and new-pet protection from one timestamp
units.description: Adds to PetCore the AD-16 rule (sleepAt, deathAt = sleepAt + 7 days, dead at exactly deathAt), the anyone-callable sleep, wake with the 10%-per-day pot-point cut that leaves level and lifetime points untouched, touch returning Status so a module that gets Dead ends with no state change, per-pet pot points and lifetime points with a GAME_MODULE awardPoints that gives an asleep pet nothing, the 3-day new-pet protection timestamp, the shield-until field and view (epic-store-pass 5.6 adds its one setter, which it sells and epic-battle 6.3 calls), per-pet care, battle and expedition counters with a GAME_MODULE increment (entry 4, epic-battle and epic-play-hub call it), the accrued-Gold counter epic-petv pays and deletes, a GAME_MODULE feed setter that entry 4's Care calls, and named empty settle points where epic-pot plugs the bucket settlement; plus the TS status port in src/lib and a shared JSON vector file both test suites read.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate (DECISIONS #2) on the status boundaries and the wake cut.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests pin asleep at exactly sleepAt, dead at exactly deathAt, wake loss day 1 = 10% to day 7 = 70% with level and lifetime points unchanged, protection ending at exactly 3 days, and awardPoints adding pot and lifetime points to an awake pet and nothing to an asleep one, and the TS status port's test passes the same vector file.

units.title: Pet Press UI kit and app shell
units.description: Sets up the shared UI layer every screen of this and later epics uses: DESIGN.md colour and type tokens for the Pet Press theme (DECISIONS #58; token names unchanged) with Bricolage Grotesque (display) + Figtree (body) + Silkscreen (money, timers, stats, rarity tags only) via next/font/google replacing Baloo 2 + Nunito and the prototype pixel fonts, the Print effects setting (default on; off = flat colour, keeps ink outlines and hard shadows), the Night Arcade skin tokens for battle, Death Match and raid screens only, the chunky SVG icons this epic needs, pill / cooldown / text buttons, die-cut card (3px ink outline, hard offset shadow), number blob, timer chip, status and alert pills, pet badge, blob stage around the existing Stage, bottom sheet, step chip with progress dots, focus ring, a copy check that fails on the banned crypto words (EXPERIENCE Voice and Tone), and the top bar with avatar plus the phone tab bar / desktop top nav carrying only the Home tab (later epics add theirs). The 3D pets get an ink outline (inverted hull) and a halftone dot ground-shadow under the feet, with no post-processing passes on the 3D canvas.
notes: DECISIONS #58: Pet Press replaces the Petverse Candy look (direction-candy.html is superseded). Owns widened (2026-10-15, recommended default) to PetModel.tsx, jelly.tsx and Stage.tsx for the 3D ink outline (inverted hull) and the halftone ground-shadow decal; no post-processing on the 3D canvas.

acceptance.clause: A kit page run locally at 390px and 1280px shows every listed component as DESIGN.md specifies, with the 3px ink focus ring reaching each one by Tab, the copy check fails on a planted "gas" string in a screen, and typecheck and lint pass.

units.title: Care: feeding spends a meal, resets the timer and earns points; the tutorial win
units.description: Adds the Care module as a GAME_MODULE: feed spends one meal from the owner's food balance kept in PetCore (which epic-store-pass and epic-play-hub later credit), calls entry 2's feed setter so the timer resets or the pet wakes with its cut, awards the feed points, counts the care action on the pet, grants the starter meals with the first hatch, and offers a one-time deterministic tutorial bot win per pet with no randomness (AD-6); the indexer projects PetFed and the food balance.
units.unknown: Owner sets the economy numbers: points per feed (EXPERIENCE copy shows +20), starter meals at hatch (copy shows 2 free meals), whether free meals refill, and the tutorial win's points (if any).

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a feed sets sleepAt to now + 3 days, adds the feed points, spends one meal and increments the care count, a feed with no meal reverts, a feed on an asleep pet wakes it with that day's cut, and the tutorial win succeeds once per pet and never loses.

units.title: Cosmetics ERC-1155 base with soulbound badges and the free starter item
units.description: Adds the one Cosmetics ERC-1155 base that epic-cosmetics-market later extends (catalogue and rarities 7.3, granted items 7.5, drop 7.6) without rebuilding it: a per-id soulbound flag under which flagged ids (Tombstone, the other badge types and the common starter item) revert on every transfer path while unflagged ids transfer, minting only through a MINTER role held by PetCore, the free common starter item PetCore mints with the first hatch (the onboarding dress-up item), and the indexer projection of cosmetics and badges held.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a soulbound id reverts on every transfer path, a rare id transfers, only the MINTER role mints, and a first hatch mints exactly one starter item that a second hatch by the same owner does not repeat.

units.title: Burial: the keeper buries due pets, burns the NFT, mints the Tombstone and gives a free egg
units.description: Adds PetCore.bury (anyone, at or after deathAt; also reached through touch): run sleep first, call the named recycle point where epic-pot returns owed ETH to the pot and the Gold-counter delete that epic-petv extends, burn the PetNFT, mint the soulbound Tombstone through entry 5, and issue a free-egg right that lets the voucher route sign one more free egg for that DID; plus the keeper job in the worker, holding a KEEPER key granted here through the timelock, that buries every due pet and reports its backlog on the health route (AD-23), and the PetBuried projection that marks the Pet row dead.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate (DECISIONS #2) on bury ordering, the free-egg right and the burn path.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show bury reverts one second before deathAt and succeeds at it, the NFT is gone, the pet's pot points are removed, and the owner holds a non-transferable Tombstone, and a worker test on a local node shows the keeper burying a due pet after time travel, after which the same login gets a voucher and hatches a free egg.

units.title: Free egg for an existing wallet only when it has history
units.description: Extends the voucher route so a login with no verified email or Google gets a free-egg voucher only when its wallet passes the history check, refusing a fresh empty wallet with a plain reason in the same error shape as entry 1's per-login refusal (which entry 9's egg screen shows), with no schema change, and binds that voucher to the wallet so the contract's per-identity cap still holds.
units.unknown: What counts as wallet history (minimum transaction count, age or balance, and on which chains) — an anti-bot rule the owner sets (AD-15).

acceptance.clause: Server tests on a local node give a voucher to a wallet fixture with history, refuse a fresh empty wallet with the standard error shape, and refuse a second voucher for the same wallet.

units.title: Landing, login sheet and egg screen as in the mocks
units.description: Replaces the tracer's plain screens with the mocked Landing (one Play button, no pot teaser until epic-pot adds it), the login sheet (email, Google, I already have a wallet, errors inside the sheet with the email kept) and the egg screen with Hatching… and Being revealed states the Couldn't hatch retry and the voucher route's refusal reason shown in plain words, and owns the route that sends a logged-out visitor to Landing, a player without a living pet (new, or after a death) to the egg and a player with one to Home.

acceptance.clause: Run locally at 390px and 1280px, a logged-out visitor sees Landing, Play opens the login sheet, a Google login without a pet lands on the egg and one with a pet lands on Home, and a forced login failure shows the error inside the sheet with the email kept.

units.title: Home shows the timer, the hungry window, feeding, asleep and wake, and passed away
units.description: Builds the Home screen states from the mocks on the UI kit, reading status only through entry 2's TS port and acting through entry 4's Care: the lime timer chip, the orange hungry chip and feed card in the last 24h, the asleep stage stating the exact point loss before the tap and the free wake by feeding, the calm passed-away card with the Tombstone and a Hatch your free egg button that opens the egg route owned by entry 9 for the free egg after death, and the pending, error and offline states, with no crypto words.

acceptance.clause: With app and worker running against a local node, time travel shows on Home the fed chip, the orange hungry chip at sleepAt minus 24h, the asleep stage whose stated loss equals the port's value, a wake by feeding that turns the chip lime, and at deathAt the passed-away card whose button hatches a new egg.

units.title: Onboarding steps 1–3 with Skip, hints and the closing card
units.description: Adds the step chip flow after the first hatch: step 1 feed (entry 4), step 2 dress up by equipping the free starter item (entry 5) through an off-chain equip route whose CosmeticEquip row the API writes and PetModel shows through LoadoutContext, step 3 the tutorial bot battle (entry 4's win) played with the existing battle visuals, the closing card; Skip on every step lands on Home, skipped steps return as small Home hints, progress is kept per user, and step 4 is left for epic-pot to insert before the closing card.

acceptance.clause: Run locally, a new login after hatch sees Step 1 of 4, feeding advances to step 2, equipping the free item advances to step 3 with the pet wearing it, the bot battle ends You won!, and skipping any step lands on Home with that step shown as a hint.

units.title: Pet life on 46630: upgrades through the timelock, Vercel and Render, and the neglect drill
units.description: Ships the epic: upgrades PetCore and deploys Care and Cosmetics through Ignition and the Safe-proposed timelock on 46630, verifies every contract on Blockscout, regenerates the chain module, runs the keeper on Render and the screens on Vercel, and runs the neglect drill on a separate drill instance whose sleep and death timers are shortened.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs every deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md); two Safe signers sign the upgrade and role grants; the owner sets the drill instance's shortened timers; the owner enters the keeper and voucher keys in Render and Vercel secrets; the owner adds Care and Cosmetics to the Gas Manager policy allow-list.
High risk: outside check = the owner runs the hatch and onboarding on their own phone and confirms the drill's bury, burn and Tombstone on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: On the Vercel production app against 46630 a fresh Google login hatches a pet and completes onboarding steps 1–3, an existing wallet with history hatches, a second free egg for that login and a fresh empty wallet are refused, every contract shows verified source on Blockscout, and on the drill instance an unfed pet sleeps, is buried by the Render keeper, its NFT is burned and its owner holds a Tombstone and hatches a free egg.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Tracer: test ETH flows PotFunder → PetCore → Home share → claim on 46630
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through every layer of the pot: newly deployed PotFunder buffers ETH and its flush (KEEPER, or anyone after 1 day) sends 85% to a two-level per-owner accumulator in PetCore (AD-4, with the eff library and K = 10,000) and 15% to a receiving-only EpochDistributor smallPot stream through the IEpochDistributor.fund interface that entry 4 builds on, PetCore claim pays the pet's owed + pending ETH and sets its pot points to 0, public views expose pot size and a pet's pending ETH, the keeper tick calls flush after sleep and bury, and the Ignition module deploys and verifies PotFunder and EpochDistributor and upgrades the live PetCore through a Safe-proposed timelocked UUPS upgrade (ERC-7201 storage appended, KEEPER granted for flush through the timelock, AD-3), and a usePot read hook (views only, AD-14) feeds a bare pot amount and Claim button on Home.

acceptance.clause: On 46630 the owner sends 0.1 test ETH to PotFunder, the keeper flushes it, PetCore's pot view shows 0.085 ETH and the smallPot stream 0.015 ETH, Home shows the pet's pending ETH from the views, and pressing Claim pays it to the player and the pet's pot points read 0.

units.title: Every settle path keeps the AD-4 balance invariant
units.description: Adds settle-before-change to every place a pet's counted points move (awardPoints, transferPoints for steals between buckets, burnPoints, sleep, wake with the AD-16 cut, bury), recycles a buried pet's owed + pending ETH 100% into the main accumulator after its points leave the bucket (CAP-6 part), turns a failed claim push into a pull balance, and ports spike 1.4's randomized invariant test into chain/test with the eff library pinned to a TS port by shared vectors; its transferPoints settle is what epic-battle waits on.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests pass, including a randomized run of award, steal, burn, sleep, wake, bury, claim and flush with zero breaks of PetCore balance = Σ owed + Σ pet pending + Σ bucket pending + undistributed + pull balances, a flush after sleep adding nothing to that pet, one owner's points split across pets earning no more than on one pet, claim gas within a fixed 5% bound between 2 and 200 owners, and wake leaving ethOwed unchanged.

units.title: Lifetime points and a level that never drops
units.description: Adds PetCore's per-pet lifetime points (raised by every point gain, never lowered by a claim, wake cut, loss or burn) and a levelOf view = 1 + floor(sqrt(lifetime ÷ 100)), plus the TS level port in src/lib that entry 8 shows, pinned to the contract by shared vectors.

acceptance.clause: Contract and TS tests pass the same vectors (0 → Lv 1, 100 → Lv 2, 12,480 → Lv 12) and show a claim, a wake cut and a lost steal leave lifetime points and level unchanged.

units.title: EpochDistributor: named streams, capped roots, delayed Merkle claims
units.description: Grows the tracer's receiving-only EpochDistributor into the AD-5 contract: smallPot, seasonPool and trophies streams with on-chain epoch length and genesis, post(stream, epoch, root, datasetHash, total) by EPOCH_POSTER rejecting total above received + rollover, a 1-hour claim delay the Safe can cancel inside, Merkle-proof claims of ETH for smallPot, rollover of unclaimed amounts after 4 epochs, and a payout hook per stream that epic-social (Guild War Gold from the AD-24 reserve) and epic-cosmetics-market (trophies) set through the timelock.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show a root over the stream's funds is rejected, a valid proof claims only after the 1-hour delay and only once, a Safe cancel inside the delay voids the root, and unclaimed ETH rolls into the epoch 4 epochs later.

units.title: Worker builds and posts the weekly small-pot epoch
units.description: Adds the epoch-builder job to the worker: after Sunday 00:00 UTC plus confirmations and once the indexer has passed the snapshot block, it takes pets awake at snapshotTs by the AD-16 status port (sleepAt as of that block), alive, older than 7 days and not on an exclusion list that epic-anti-bot fills, replays indexed point events up to the snapshot block, cuts the bottom half by raw points, gives equal shares, builds the tree with @openzeppelin/merkle-tree (DECISIONS #32), stores Epoch and EpochLeaf rows (writer = epoch builder) and posts the root with the EPOCH_POSTER key.

acceptance.clause: A worker test on a local node and a test_ schema builds an epoch whose posted root matches the leaves, includes only the bottom half of eligible pets in equal shares, and excludes a pet with sleepAt == snapshotTs, a dead pet and a 6-day-old pet.

units.title: Public dataset route rebuilds every epoch root
units.description: Serves each posted epoch's full dataset (stream, epoch, snapshot block number and hash, leaves, total) and a pet's proof from a public, unauthenticated API route, and ships a standalone rebuild script that recomputes the root and datasetHash from that route alone.

acceptance.clause: On a local node and a test_ schema, running the rebuild script against the route for an epoch posted by entry 5 prints the same root and datasetHash as the EpochDistributor's on-chain record.

units.title: Read-only ETH/USD display rate for dollars-first money
units.description: Adds one read-only ETH/USD display-rate port with a short server cache and a dollars-first formatter (dollars large, ETH small underneath) that every screen uses; epic-petv adds PETV/USD to the same port, and the signed payment quote stays in epic-store-pass (AD-10).
units.unknown: Which ETH/USD source feeds the testnet dollar display (initiative open question; DECISIONS #8 names Chainlink for mainnet only)?

acceptance.clause: A unit test formats 0.018 ETH at a fixed 2,338 rate as "$42.08" over "0.018 ETH", and a server test with the source down returns the last cached rate with its age, or ETH only when none is cached.

units.title: Home pot blob and claim sheet as in the mocks
units.description: Builds the pot number blob (pot size and live share, dollars first, "No pot share while asleep" when asleep) and the claim sheet from key-shop-claim.html (Claim $X over ETH, pot points from → to 0, "stays Lv N" from entry 3, 85/15 explainer bar, Not now, disabled zero-share state, pending and failure copy, Check this result link to PetCore's public views, the EXPERIENCE focus order), and the "Bunny · Lv N" level badge on the Home pet card from entry 3, with a shared dollars-first PotAmount component entry 9 reuses; Check this result links to the public share views until epic-launch's fairness sheet takes the link.

acceptance.clause: Component and server tests on a local node with a funded pot show the blob and sheet amounts equal PetCore's views at the fixed test rate, claiming leaves the points blob at 0 with the level unchanged, an asleep pet's blob reads "No pot share while asleep", the Home pet badge shows the level from levelOf, and initial focus lands on the sheet title.

units.title: Landing pot teaser and onboarding step 4 "see the pot"
units.description: Adds the live pot teaser to the logged-out landing page and onboarding step 4 ("Prize pot $X · Your points = $Y now", skippable, advances when seen) on epic-pet-life's onboarding shell, both reading usePot and PotAmount.

acceptance.clause: With a funded pot on a local node, the logged-out landing page shows the pot in dollars over ETH, and a new player's onboarding step 4 shows the pot and their pet's share in dollars and completes or skips onboarding.

units.title: Claims list with small-pot payouts and claim history
units.description: Adds Avatar menu › Claims, listing the player's open small-pot payouts (proof from entry 6's route, claimed on EpochDistributor) and past claims (adding the Claims item to the Avatar menu, creating the menu if epic-pet-life has not), and indexer handlers that write the Claim projection from PotClaimed and the small-pot claim event so the top-5% payout share is measurable.

acceptance.clause: A server and worker test on a local node shows a pet in a posted epoch listed with its dollar amount, claimed once through the list, and both its main-pot and small-pot claims written once each to the Claim projection after a worker restart.

units.title: Pot contracts upgraded on 46630 and a testnet bury recycles ETH
units.description: Upgrades PetCore (settle paths and level) and EpochDistributor on 46630 through a Safe-proposed timelocked upgrade, verifies them on Blockscout, regenerates the chain module, grants EPOCH_POSTER through the timelock, and runs one testnet bury of a pet holding pot ETH on epic-pet-life's shortened-timer test deploy.

acceptance.clause: Tx hashes on 46630 show the timelocked upgrade and role grant, the Blockscout source is verified, after the bury the pet's owed + pending ETH appears in PetCore's main accumulator with the AD-4 balance view still equal, and a claim on 46630 sets pot points to 0 while levelOf and lifetime points stay unchanged.

units.title: First weekly small-pot epoch closes and pays on testnet
units.description: Runs the epoch builder on the Render worker against 46630 and the game schema with the EPOCH_POSTER key, so the first real Sunday 00:00 UTC epoch posts a root, the public route on Vercel serves its dataset, an eligible player claims the share in the deployed app, and the deployed landing teaser and onboarding step 4 read the live pot.

acceptance.clause: With a test pet hatched more than 7 days before the epoch and kept fed, after the first Sunday epoch on 46630 the rebuild script run against the Vercel route reproduces the posted root, and a test player claims their small-pot share in the app and sees it on the explorer, and on the Vercel app the landing teaser and a new player's onboarding step 4 show the live 46630 pot in dollars.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Tracer: a PETV burn on a local node reaches the Wallet sheet burn counter
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through contract, deploy, indexer, API and screen: the non-upgradeable PETV ERC-20 minting 1B once into the five allocation recipients passed to its constructor (curve 40, liquidity 20, faucet 15, Gold reserve 15, team 10; no mint function) with `burn` emitting `Burned(source, amount)` (deployed after the recipient proxies, which are initialized with its address later; entries 2, 5 and 9 rely on this order), its own Ignition module, its entry in the generated chain module, the worker indexing `Burned` from every contract listed as a burn source into a burn-total projection, and a Wallet item in epic-pot's avatar menu (entry 3.10) opening a Wallet sheet showing the player's PETV balance and the total burned in PETV; entries 3, 7 and 8 build on this event, projection and sheet.

acceptance.clause: With app and worker running against a Hardhat local node, burning PETV from a test account raises the Wallet sheet's burned total by that amount within a minute, and a contract test shows total supply 1B split 40/20/15/15/10 to the recipients with no callable mint.

units.title: The Pons-like curve graduates at 4.2 test ETH into our own v2-style pool
units.description: Adds PonsLikeCurve (UUPS behind the timelock, graduation threshold a timelocked parameter) that sells the curve allocation for test ETH and, at 4.2 test ETH raised, graduates once by seeding our own v2-style pair (its proxy deployed before PETV and initialized with PETV's address, per entry 1) and router on 46630 with the raised ETH and the liquidity allocation, after which the curve refuses trades; tax-free here, entry 3 adds the tax to both venues.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs the throwaway rehearsal deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md) and funds the deployer with the test ETH the rehearsal needs.
High risk: outside check = the owner confirms the rehearsal graduation and pool swap on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests pin graduation at exactly 4.2 ETH, show the pair holding the seeded reserves, curve trades reverting after graduation and pool swaps working, and a throwaway rehearsal instance on 46630 graduates and takes one pool swap with tx hashes recorded in the plan.

units.title: Every curve and pool trade pays 5% into TaxSplitter, split 2/1/1/1
units.description: Makes both venues take 5% of every trade (no router bypass) and send it to TaxSplitter, which splits by timelocked basis points (default 2% pot, 1% burn, 1% liquidity, 1% team): the pot share goes to epic-pot's PotFunder, the burn share is burned emitting `Burned`, the liquidity share is added to the pool, and the team share goes to the team address.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate (DECISIONS #2) on tax bypass and splitter rounding.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests on curve buys and sells and on pool swaps (including a direct pair swap) show exactly 5% taken and split 2/1/1/1, PotFunder's balance up by the pot share, one `Burned` event for the burn share, and a bps change reverting unless executed through the timelock.

units.title: GoldVault: stake PETV for Gold shares, swap back for a 2% fee
units.description: Adds GoldVault (UUPS behind the timelock): depositing PETV mints Gold shares at the vault's share price, swapping back burns shares and pays PETV minus a timelocked 2% fee that stays in the vault for remaining stakers, anyone can add PETV to grow the vault without minting shares, and Gold shares cannot be sent to contracts that are not allow-listed (AD-22).
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on share-price rounding and first-depositor inflation.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a stake mints shares only for PETV deposited, a swap back returns 98% at an unchanged share price with the 2% raising it for the rest, an added-PETV call mints nothing, and a Gold transfer to a non-allow-listed contract reverts.

units.title: Gold reserve and the 0.1% daily cap behind creditFromGame
units.description: Deposits the 15% Gold reserve allocation into GoldVault once (proxy deployed before PETV, per entry 1), holding its shares in the reserve account, and adds `creditFromGame(player, amount)` (PetCore only) that moves existing reserve shares to the player under a timelocked daily UTC cap of 0.1% of the reserve and returns the amount actually paid so PetCore keeps the rest unpaid (entry 6 relies on this), plus views for reserve size, paid today and the cap that entry 7 reads.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on the cap and the PetCore-only gate.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests pin the cap at 0.1% of the reserve per UTC day, show over-cap and empty-reserve credit returning the unpaid remainder, total Gold shares unchanged by any game credit, the cap resetting at the next UTC day, and a non-PetCore caller reverting.

units.title: PetCore accrues a living pet's Gold, pays it from the reserve and deletes it on death
units.description: Adds PetCore's per-pet accrued-Gold counter, growing 10 Gold a day for a living pet (timelocked parameter, from the AD-16 timestamps), pays it through `GoldVault.creditFromGame` (entry 5) on a player's Gold claim, keeping any unpaid remainder in the counter for a later day, and fills epic-pet-life's Gold-counter delete point in bury (entry 2.6) so the unpaid Gold stays in the reserve (CAP-6 part), settling in the order epic-pot's entry 3.2 sets; storage changes pass the upgrade-safety validator.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on PetCore's reentrancy lock and settle order.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show 10 Gold accrued per living day, a living pet's Gold claim paid from the reserve with no shares minted, an over-cap claim leaving the remainder in the counter and paying it the next UTC day, and a buried pet's counter deleted with the reserve unchanged.

units.title: PETV/USD joins the display-rate service and the burn total is served in dollars
units.description: Adds PETV/USD to epic-pot's read-only display-rate service, from the curve price before graduation and the pool price after, times its ETH/USD rate (price before tax, as entry 3 leaves it), and serves the burn total, ETH, PETV and Gold balances and today's Gold cap with their dollar values from one API route that entry 8 renders; display only, never a payment quote (AD-10 stays with epic-store-pass).

acceptance.clause: API tests against a local node return a PETV/USD rate equal to the curve (then pool) spot price times the stubbed ETH/USD rate, and a burned total whose dollar value matches it, before and after a graduation.

units.title: Wallet sheet: balances dollars first, Gold vault stake and swap back, burn counter
units.description: Completes the Wallet sheet from entry 1 per EXPERIENCE: ETH, PETV and Gold balances and the burn counter dollars first with PETV small underneath (from entry 7's route), a Gold vault stake confirm step and swap back with "Swapping back costs 2%" shown before it, sent through the GameWallet port, with Empty, Loading and Error states and no crypto words; the faucet button is epic-store-pass's.

acceptance.clause: On a local node a test player opens the Wallet sheet, stakes 100 PETV through the confirm step and swaps back with the 2% notice shown first, and the PETV, Gold and burned totals update dollars first; a UI test fails if a word from EXPERIENCE's avoid list appears, except in the required copy "Swapping back costs 2%".

units.title: The token layer is live and verified on 46630
units.description: Deploys, in entry 1's order (recipient proxies, then PETV, then their initialization), PETV with its allocation recipients, PonsLikeCurve, the v2-style pair and router, TaxSplitter and GoldVault with the reserve deposit through Ignition to 46630, verifies each on Blockscout, upgrades PetCore through the Safe-proposed timelock for Gold payment, grants roles, registers the burn sources with the worker, regenerates the chain module, and checks the epic's Done when live.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs every deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md) and funds the deployer; two Safe signers sign the PetCore upgrade and role grants through the timelock.
High risk: outside check = the owner and one other Safe signer confirm the deploy, the split and the Gold claim on the explorer.

acceptance.clause: On 46630 every new contract shows verified source, total supply reads 1B split 40/20/15/15/10, one curve buy and one sell show the 2/1/1/1 split with PotFunder receiving the pot share and the Vercel Wallet sheet's burn counter rising, a stake and swap back work there, and a living pet's Gold claim pays from the reserve.

units.title: Tracer: buy food for $1 in PETV at a signed rate on a local node
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through contract, signer, deploy and screen: the IPriceSource port (petvPerUsd, weiPerUsd, burnStageBps) with the upgradeable SignedRateSource accepting an EIP-712 QUOTE_SIGNER quote (expiry, nonce, at most 5% move per hour from the last accepted rate, burn stage only 7000/5000/3000), an upgradeable Store whose registry holds Food at 100 USD cents that converts at the accepted quote, burns the burn-stage share emitting `Burned` (registered as a burn source), sends half the rest to a receive-only PotConverter and half to the team address and credits one meal to PetCore's food balance, a quote route signing at 70% from the PETV/USD display rate, each contract's own Ignition module and generated-chain-module entry, and a Shop tab with Shop › Store showing Food dollars first and buying it through the GameWallet port; entries 6, 8 and 9 build on these contracts and route.
notes: hitl steps: the owner puts a dev QUOTE_SIGNER key in the local env (never printed or committed).
High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate (DECISIONS #2) on quote replay, the rate-move bound and the burn-stage source.

acceptance.clause: With app and worker on a Hardhat local node, a logged-in player opens Shop › Store, sees Food at $1 over its PETV amount, buys it and the food count rises by one, and contract tests show 70% of the PETV burned with `Burned`, 15% held by PotConverter, 15% at the team address, and an expired, replayed or 6%-moved quote reverting.

units.title: Gas webhook: 10 sponsored actions a day per player, 20 with the Pass, fail closed
units.description: Adds `/api/gas/approve` as the Gas Manager custom-rules webhook: it verifies Alchemy's signature, maps `userOperation.sender` to a Privy DID through the User row, approves only a single call to an allow-listed game contract, counts approvals per DID per UTC day in a SponsorshipCount model (single writer: this route) against a cap of 10, or 20 while `ISeasonPass.isActive` is true (the interface and a test double defined here; entry 10 implements it), sponsors calls to an uncounted list (the Faucet, from entry 4) without counting, refuses on any error, and serves the player's remaining count from `/api/gas/remaining` for entry 3.
notes: hitl steps: the owner sets the custom-rules webhook URL on the Gas Manager policy with approveOnFailure off, and enters the webhook signing key in Vercel's preview env (never printed or committed).
High risk: outside check = the security review in the gate on signature verification and fail-closed paths.

acceptance.clause: Route tests with recorded Gas Manager fixtures approve a DID's first 10 single-call operations of a UTC day and refuse the 11th, a batch, a non-allow-listed target, a bad signature, an unknown sender and a database error, approve up to 20 when the SeasonPass double is active, and on a Vercel preview against 46630 the 11th tracer action of the day is refused by the live policy.

units.title: Faucet: sign-up and daily drips against a voucher per Privy DID
units.description: Adds the upgradeable testnet Faucet behind the timelock paying 0.01 test ETH + 3,120 PETV once per DID hash at sign-up and 0.002 test ETH + 624 PETV once per DID hash per UTC day (amounts timelocked parameters), only against a VOUCHER_SIGNER voucher (kind, DID hash, recipient, UTC day, expiry, nonce) from a faucet route next to epic-pet-life's voucher route, receiving team test-ETH top-ups and refusing with a plain reason when empty, with its own Ignition module; entry 5 calls it and entry 2 lists it as uncounted.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on voucher replay and per-DID caps.

acceptance.clause: Contract and route tests show a sign-up voucher pays 0.01 test ETH + 3,120 PETV once per DID, a daily voucher pays 0.002 test ETH + 624 PETV once per DID per UTC day, a reused, expired, wrong-recipient or unsigned voucher and a logged-out request are refused, an empty faucet refuses, and only the timelock changes the amounts.

units.title: Wallet sheet faucet: the sign-up drip and "Get today's $2" with its countdown
units.description: Adds the faucet to epic-petv's Wallet sheet: the sign-up drip is claimed automatically after the first login (with a retry button if it fails), the daily button shows the live dollar value of the drip and becomes a cooldown button counting down to 00:00 UTC once used, with pending, error and empty-faucet copy, and exposes the faucet section as the target that entries 3, 7 and 12 open.

acceptance.clause: On a local node a new login receives the sign-up drip without tapping, and on the next UTC day the Wallet sheet button pays the daily drip and turns into a cooldown button counting down to 00:00 UTC, at 390px and 1280px.

units.title: Past the cap: the paid fallback, the free-actions chip and the no-test-ETH state
units.description: When entry 2's remaining count is 0, sends the same call unsponsored through the GameWallet port after a fee confirm that shows the fee in dollars first (gas estimate × fee × epic-pot's ETH/USD rate), adds the top-bar free-actions chip ("7 free left", "0 free · small fee", polite announcement on change) and the no-test-ETH fee confirm with "Get test ETH" opening the Wallet sheet and the reset time, spending nothing.

acceptance.clause: On a local node with the webhook fixture at the cap, the 11th action shows its fee in dollars, goes through paid from test ETH and the chip reads "0 free · small fee", the chip shows "10 free left" again after the UTC day turns, and with no test ETH the fee confirm offers "Get test ETH" and the reset time and sends nothing.

units.title: Store registry: eggs and the 8-hour shield, open to later items
units.description: Grows entry 1's Store into the full registry: Egg (299 cents) and Lucky egg (999 cents) mint a paid egg through a new PetCore entry point with its tier, whose hatch reveal uses that tier's coat weights (the Lucky egg triples the rarest palettes' weight, a timelocked parameter), Shield (8h, 100 cents) sets the pet's shield-until (epic-pet-life 2.2's field) through a GAME_MODULE extend-only shield setter this entry adds to PetCore, the one setter epic-battle 6.3 also calls (this entry is the only one that builds paid eggs and the Shield), every price is a timelocked USD-cents parameter, and later epics register items (evolution items, cosmetics) through the timelock with a target contract and call, so epic-growth and epic-cosmetics-market add items without editing Store.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests buy each item at a signed rate (a meal credited, an Egg and a Lucky egg minted with their tier and a seeded run of Lucky-egg reveals showing the rarest palettes at three times the Egg rate, a pet's shield set to now + 8 hours), show only the timelock can change a price or register an item, and the AD-4 invariant and upgrade-safety validator stay clean after the PetCore change.

units.title: Shop › Store and the not-enough-PETV shortfall note as in the mock
units.description: Builds Shop › Store from key-shop-claim.html on entry 6's registry: item tiles dollars first with PETV underneath, the detail and Buy area, the wallet chip opening the Wallet sheet, pending and error states, and the shared shortfall note (Buy becomes a focusable "Not enough PETV"; "You need $1.40 more" over the PETV gap; "Get today's $2" or "Open Wallet" with the next-drip time, opening entry 5's faucet section and returning to the same item) that entry 12 and later epics reuse.

acceptance.clause: At 390px and 1280px against a local node, Shop › Store lists Food, Egg, Lucky egg and Shield dollars first, a buy succeeds, and with too little PETV the note states the gap in dollars and its button opens the Wallet sheet faucet and returns to the same item, all reachable by keyboard.

units.title: The quote service sets the burn stage from the 30-minute market cap and stays inside the bound
units.description: Hardens entry 1's quote route: burnStageBps comes from the 30-minute average market cap (PETV/USD × 1B supply: 7000 below $1M, 5000 from $1M, 3000 from $10M, thresholds in GameConfig), quotes expire after 5 minutes with an on-chain nonce, a market move past 5% in an hour is signed at the bound so buys keep working, the route is rate-limited per DID, and the QUOTE_SIGNER key is loaded only through the env loader and never logged.

acceptance.clause: Route tests sign 7000 below a $1M average, 5000 above it and 3000 above $10M, sign a rate at exactly the 5%-per-hour bound when the market moved further, and a log-capture test finds no key material.

units.title: PotConverter swaps queued PETV to ETH for PotFunder
units.description: Turns entry 1's receive-only PotConverter into the AD-11 converter: a KEEPER-only batch swap of queued PETV to ETH through the curve before graduation and the pool after, with a minimum-out from IPriceSource's weiPerUsd and petvPerUsd less the 5% trade tax and a timelocked slippage allowance, the ETH sent to epic-pot's PotFunder, plus the keeper job in the worker that runs it on a schedule and when the queue passes a threshold.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on minimum-out and sandwich exposure.

acceptance.clause: Worker tests on a local node show the job swapping queued PETV through the curve and, after graduation, the pool, PotFunder's balance rising by the ETH received, a swap below the minimum-out reverting, and a non-KEEPER call reverting.

units.title: SeasonPass: on-chain seasons and a $7.99 pass with no auto-renew
units.description: Adds the upgradeable SeasonPass implementing entry 2's ISeasonPass: season genesis and 12-week length as timelocked parameters behind `seasonOf(ts)` and `isActive(addr, ts)`, a buy of the current season at 799 cents through entry 1's price source that lasts to that season's end with no renewal and one pass per address per season, income split 30% to PotConverter, 20% to epic-pot's seasonPool stream and 50% to team in the same transaction, and a grant of the current season's skin on buy through the Cosmetics base's granter interface (epic-pet-life 2.5), the skin id a timelocked per-season SeasonPass parameter left unset (no skin) until epic-cosmetics-market 7.5 defines the soulbound skin id and its granter role and epic-seasons sets the id each season (10.8, 10.10), with its own Ignition module.
notes: High risk: outside check = the adversarial review in the gate on season boundaries and the income split.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show seasonOf and isActive following genesis and the 12-week length at the exact boundaries, a $7.99 buy making isActive true until the season's end and false after, a second buy in the same season reverting, the 30/20/50 split, and the season skin minted and refusing transfer.

units.title: PetCore gives +25% points to Pass holders
units.description: Makes PetCore, which alone applies multipliers (AD-2), raise every point award by 25% (rounded down) while the pet's owner has `SeasonPass.isActive`, through a timelocked SeasonPass address and multiplier, with storage changes passing the upgrade-safety validator.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a point award to an active holder's pet is 25% higher and back to normal after the season ends, a steal or burn is not multiplied, and the AD-4 invariant test and upgrade-safety validator stay clean.

units.title: Shop › Pass: the pass card, buying and the owned state
units.description: Builds Shop › Pass from key-shop-claim.html on entry 10: the pass card with the skin preview, $7.99 dollars first, the instead-of benefit rows (+25% points, attack every 10 minutes instead of 30, 20 free actions instead of 10, season skin), "No auto-renew", the buy step, the owned state "You have the Season Pass · Week N of 12" with room for epic-seasons' reward track, and entry 7's shortfall note when PETV is short.

acceptance.clause: At 390px and 1280px against a local node, Shop › Pass shows the mock's card, buying turns it into the owned state with the right week and the free-actions chip reads "20 free left", and too little PETV shows the shortfall note, all reachable by keyboard.

units.title: Store, Pass and faucet live on 46630 and the Done when checked
units.description: Deploys SignedRateSource, Store, PotConverter, Faucet and SeasonPass through Ignition to 46630 and upgrades PetCore through the Safe-proposed timelock, verifies each on Blockscout, grants QUOTE_SIGNER, KEEPER and the Store's PetCore role through the timelock (SeasonPass's season-skin granter role comes with epic-cosmetics-market 7.13), moves the faucet PETV allocation to the Faucet, sets season 1's genesis, regenerates the chain module, points the gas webhook at the live SeasonPass and lists the live Faucet as uncounted, runs the quote route on Vercel and the keeper on Render, and checks every Done when item live.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs every deploy and upgrade to 46630 (CLAUDE.md); two Safe signers sign the timelocked role grants, the PetCore upgrade, the faucet PETV transfer and season 1's genesis; the owner funds the Faucet with test ETH and the QUOTE_SIGNER and KEEPER keys with gas; the owner enters the QUOTE_SIGNER key in Vercel and the KEEPER key in Render (never printed); the owner adds Store, Faucet and SeasonPass to the Gas Manager policy allow-list and points the production webhook at the Vercel route.
High risk: outside check = the owner confirms the live drips, purchases and the 11th/21st action on the explorer.
units.unknown: Season 1 genesis date (initiative open question); assumed: the Sunday 00:00 UTC on which testnet opens.

acceptance.clause: On the Vercel production app against 46630 a fresh login gets the sign-up drip, has its 11th action of the day refused for sponsorship and paid with the fee in dollars, buys food and the Pass at the signed rate, takes 20 sponsored actions and then a paid one with the fee in dollars, claims the next day's drip, a keeper run raises PotFunder's balance, and every new contract shows verified source on Blockscout.
