units.title: Tracer: one attack from the Battle tab to a result on 46630
units.description: Delivers the thinnest attack path through every layer: the pure BattleMath library (power from level, asleep / hungry state and the element edge, +10% power when the pet's element beats the opponent's (fire > leaf > stone > spark > water > fire, DECISIONS #55), win chance in bps, 5% steal) with a TS port in src/lib/battle pinned by shared vectors, an upgradeable Battle module whose attack(myPet, target, commitment, sig) checks only level ±2 and same owner, registers with the Randomness service and on settle moves 5% of the target's points through PetCore.transferPoints and emits PetRobbed, a previewAttack view, the worker indexing PetRobbed into a BattleRecord projection, the Ignition module and generated chain module entry, and a bare Battle › Attack list showing each target's "Win +N · X% chance" from the view with a tap that ends on a plain result line; entries 2, 3, 6 and 8 build on BattleMath, the view and the projection.
units.unknown: Does the owner accept the assumed stats and win-odds formula in this epic's Notes (power = 100 + 10 × level, ×0.85 hungry, ×0.5 asleep, ×1.10 when the pet's element beats the opponent's per DECISIONS #55; chance = A ÷ (A + D) clamped 10–90%; steal 500 bps of the target's points)?

acceptance.clause: On 46630 a test player taps Attack on a second test pet within ±2 levels, the result line shows won or lost after the reveal, a win moves exactly 5% of the target's points (PetCore views before and after), the BattleRecord row has the tx hash, and the chain/ tests recompute the winner from the revealed seed with BattleMath and match the TS port's vectors.

units.title: Match tickets and ranked duels in MatchArena
units.description: Adds the MatchArena module and the multi-seat match protocol other modes reuse: a MATCHMAKER-signed EIP-712 MatchTicket (matchId, mode, pets, stake tier, expiry) that each seat joins on-chain with its own Randomness commitment, the match registering its request when the last seat joins, anyone cancelling an unfilled match after expiry, eligibility re-checked at settlement (level ±2, protection, same owner or co-owner, asleep), and the ranked duel on it: 5 per pet per UTC day, the winner takes 10% of the loser's points through PetCore.transferPoints, rank moves Elo-style from 1,000 (±16 at even odds) keyed by SeasonPass.seasonOf so a new season starts at 1,000, and each settled duel increments both pets' PetCore battle counter; the EIP-712 ticket check is a MatchTicket library this entry owns and entries 5 and 6 only call, and the entry adds MatchArena's own Ignition module and its generated chain module entry so local-node tests in entries 4 and 10 deploy it.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show a duel joined by both seats settles from the revealed seed with the BattleMath winner taking exactly 10% of the loser's points and ranks moving 1,000 → 1,016 / 984 at even odds, a sixth duel in one UTC day reverts, a forged or expired ticket reverts, an unfilled match cancels after expiry, a pet that levels out of range before settlement gets the no-op, a reveal timeout moves no points and gives the day's duel back, and after a season boundary both pets read rank 1,000 again.

units.title: Attack rules: shields, cooldown, protection, revenge
units.description: Completes Battle's attack rules on the tracer: eligibility checked at commit and again at settlement (level ±2, new-pet protection, shield, cooldown, same owner or co-owner, one pending fight per target, an asleep attacker refused, asleep targets allowed), a 30-minute per-pet cooldown that is 10 minutes when SeasonPass.isActive(owner), a 30-minute shield written to PetCore after a robbery through epic-store-pass 5.6's shield setter (the only shield setter), one revenge right per robbery on the attacker that skips the cooldown and the target's shield and expires after 24 hours, attacking ending the attacker's own new-pet protection, the PetCore battle counter incremented per fight, the timeout no-op giving the cooldown back, and views (previewAttack reasons, cooldownEnds, revengeOf) entry 9 reads.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests pin every attack default (5%, ±2, 30 / 10 minutes, 30-minute shield, 24-hour revenge) and show each eligibility rule reverting at commit and turning into a no-op when it changes before settlement, a revenge skipping cooldown and shield once and then reverting, and a Pass holder attacking again after 10 minutes.

units.title: 2v2 matches split 10% of the losing team's points
units.description: Adds the 2v2 mode to MatchArena on entry 2's four-seat ticket: team power is the sum of both pets' BattleMath power, 5 per pet per UTC day, every seat re-checked at settlement, each settled match incrementing all four pets' PetCore battle counter, each losing pet loses 10% of its points and the total is split evenly between the two winners through PetCore.transferPoints, rank unchanged, and a settle event naming both teams that epic-social's Guild War series reuses; it calls entry 2's MatchTicket library without changing it.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show a filled 2v2 settles from the revealed seed with each loser down exactly 10% and each winner up half the total (dust to the first winner), two pets of one owner on opposite teams or level +3 revert, a sixth 2v2 in one UTC day reverts, and a timeout moves no points.

units.title: Wager duels: PETV stakes, 5% burn, refund on timeout
units.description: Adds the Wager module (tokens only, never points, AD-2) on entry 2's ticket protocol: each seat escrows the same PETV stake tier when it joins (approve and join in one batched call), the pets are checked for level ±2 and different owners or co-owners at join and again at settlement (reading PetCore, never writing it), the BattleMath winner from the revealed seed takes the pot minus 5% which is burned through PETV.burn emitting Burned, both stakes are refunded on a reveal timeout or an unfilled ticket's cancel, stake tiers are timelocked parameters, a stakeTiers view the wager screen reads, Wager's own Ignition module and chain module entry, and Wager registered as a burn source in the local-node worker config so entry 11's burn counter moves; it calls entry 2's MatchTicket library without changing it.
units.unknown: Does the owner accept the assumed wager and dice stake tiers in this epic's Notes (312 / 624 / 1,560 / 3,120 PETV, about $1 / $2 / $5 / $10) and 5% burn as the only fee?

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show a settled wager pays the winner exactly 95% of the pot and emits one Burned for 5%, a stake outside the tiers reverts, pets at level +3 or of one owner revert at join and no-op at settlement, both stakes return in full on a reveal timeout and on an expired unfilled ticket, Wager never writes to PetCore (no transferPoints), and a tier change reverts unless executed through the timelock.

units.title: Matchmaking queue, ticket signer and match indexing
units.description: Adds the server side of entry 2's protocol: a MatchQueue table written only by the API, authenticated routes to join, leave and poll a queue per mode (duel, 2v2 with an invite-link team or a random partner, wager per stake tier) that pair the oldest waiting entries within level ±2 and different owners and sign a MatchTicket with the MATCHMAKER key, re-queueing seats whose ticket expires unfilled, plus the worker indexing MatchArena and Wager join, settle and cancel events into BattleRecord so the queue and screens see each match's state; entries 10 and 11 call these routes.

acceptance.clause: Server tests on a test_ schema and a Hardhat local node show two players queued for a duel get one signed ticket both can join on-chain, a third player at level +3 is never paired, a 2v2 invite link puts both friends on one team, "Stop looking" removes the entry with nothing spent, an expired unfilled ticket re-queues the joined seat, and the indexed BattleRecord shows the settled match.

units.title: Dice tables: two players, one roll, 5% burned
units.description: Adds dice to the Wager module: a player opens a table by escrowing a stake tier, a second player joins with the same stake and a Randomness commitment, the revealed seed picks the winner 50/50, the winner takes the pot minus 5% burned through PETV.burn, the opener can cancel an unjoined table for a full refund, a reveal timeout refunds both, and an openTables view the Dice card reads.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show a joined table pays the seed's winner exactly 95% of the pot with one Burned event, the winner recomputes from the revealed seed, a cancel before join refunds the opener, a reveal timeout refunds both stakes, and a mismatched stake reverts.

units.title: Fight playback and result screens
units.description: Builds the shared fight and result components entries 9–11, epic-play-hub and epic-death-match-raid reuse: a deterministic fight script in src/lib/battle from the revealed seed, both powers and the on-chain winner (3–5 rounds, health from 100, the winner never reaching 0), the fight view with nameplates, health bars, hit labels and the role=log battle text box, "Skip to result", the "Being revealed · nothing for you to do" pill while waiting, reduce-motion behaviour (prefers-reduced-motion; the in-app Calm motion switch has no owning entry yet and is added where it is built), and the won and lost result cards per the mock (points won, new total, share in dollars, cooldown button, gentle loss copy), wired into the tracer's attack in place of its result line.

acceptance.clause: Component tests show the same seed always gives the same script ending in the on-chain winner, the log reads each round with both health values, focus moves to the result heading, and under reduce motion no hit labels render; in the running app an attack plays the fight and ends on the mock's won or lost card.

units.title: Battle tab: Attack segment as in the mock
units.description: Completes Battle › Attack from entry 3's views: segmented tabs (Attack / Duel / 2v2 with their limit lines), the revenge row ("Win +N · X%", "Revenge, no wait"), target rows within ±2 levels with reward and chance before the tap, asleep and shielded states, the live cooldown button ("Attack in 12m", 10m with a Pass), the Empty state, desktop sort by best chance, keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, one-tap attack and revenge through the GameWallet port into entry 8's fight.

acceptance.clause: In the running app against a local node a robbed test player sees the revenge row, revenge plays without waiting, the next attack shows "Attack in 30m" counting down in the button, a shielded target shows "Safe for now" with its time, and every row and button is reachable and named by keyboard alone with the cooldown button announced as "Attack, available in N minutes".

units.title: Duel (Ranked) and 2v2 screens with matching
units.description: Builds Battle › Duel › Ranked and Battle › 2v2 from the spine: "Win: +rank and 10% of their points" shown before "Find a match", rank and "5 left today" from MatchArena views, "Team up with a friend" by invite link or "Random partner", the "Finding a match…" state with "Stop looking", joining the signed ticket through the GameWallet port, entry 8's fight, and results with the rank change or "Your team won. +N points each."

acceptance.clause: In the running app against a local node two test players find a ranked duel, both join, the fight plays and the winner's result shows +16 rank and 10% of the loser's points; two friends joined by an invite link beat a random pair and each sees half the team's winnings; "Stop looking" spends nothing.

units.title: Wager flow, Play tab shell and Dice card
units.description: Builds Battle › Duel › Wager (stake chips in dollars with PETV under, the danger note "You can lose your stake. 5% of the pot is burned." before commit, confirm sheet, matching, fight, win and loss results with the burn counter ticking "+$N burned" from entry 6's registered burn source, the not-enough-PETV shortfall note with epic-store-pass's faucet "Get today's $2") and the Play tab shell (card grid epic-play-hub and epic-death-match-raid add their cards to) with the Dice card: open or join a table at a stake, the danger note, the roll result and the burn counter.

acceptance.clause: In the running app against a local node a test player stakes the $5 tier, sees the danger note and confirm sheet before any PETV moves, wins and sees 95% of the pot and the burn counter rise by 5%; a player short of PETV sees the shortfall note; on the Play tab two players play one dice table to a result.

units.title: Battles live on 46630
units.description: Upgrades Battle and deploys MatchArena and Wager to 46630 through the Safe-proposed timelock, verifies them on Blockscout, grants GAME_MODULE, the Randomness consumer and MATCHMAKER roles and registers Wager as a burn source with the worker, regenerates the chain module, puts the MATCHMAKER key in Vercel's secrets, and checks the epic's Done when with test players in the deployed app.

acceptance.clause: On the Vercel app against 46630 test players complete a robbery with revenge and the 30-minute shield, a ranked duel, a 2v2, a wager and a dice table, each result checks against its revealed commitment on the explorer, and the burn counter rises by the two 5% burns.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Tracer: buy one rare hat in the Store on 46630 and see the pet wear it
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through every layer: the live Cosmetics ERC-1155 from epic-pet-life (2.5, live in 2.11) is upgraded through the Safe-proposed timelock with one rare, tradeable hat (Propeller cap, $4) that the Store item registry sells, the generated chain module carries it into src/, epic-pet-life's holdings projection records the purchase, epic-pet-life's off-chain equip route (2.10, CosmeticEquip written by the API, AD-1, AD-12) accepts it after checking the holding, and Home renders the pet wearing it through PetModel's existing loadout prop without editing src/components/three; this timelocked upgrade path is the one entries 3–6 and 13 reuse.

acceptance.clause: On the Vercel app against 46630 a test player buys the Propeller cap for $4 in PETV, a CosmeticHolding row appears within a minute, Equip puts it on the pet on Home and it is still worn after a reload, and equipping an item the player does not hold is refused.

units.title: Every item fits all 10 species, babies and armless pets included
units.description: Settles the CAP-18 hand conflict by giving babies and armless (winged) species a hand anchor for held items and adding a fit table in src/components/three so all 35 items render on all 10 species in baby and adult form without clipping; it edits only src/components/three (src/lib/cosmetics.ts and its stale hand comment are entry 3's), and entry 11 reuses its fit test.

acceptance.clause: A node:test fit test passes for every item × species × stage (35 × 10 × 2) resolving an anchor, and the owner approves the Gallery contact sheet showing each slot's items on every species, baby and adult.

units.title: The 35-item catalogue with rarities, prices and transfer rules
units.description: Registers all 35 items from one catalogue file (token id, visual key from src/lib/cosmetics.ts, slot, rarity split 21 common / 9 rare / 4 epic / 1 legendary and USD prices, both assumptions the owner confirms) on Cosmetics and in the Store and carries it into the generated chain module, setting each item's soulbound flag through 2.5's per-id flag (commons soulbound, rare-and-better transferable) without adding a second transfer rule; epic-pet-life's starter item keeps its token id as one of the 21 commons, Tombstone and badges are untouched, and entries 7 and 10 read item data only from this module.

acceptance.clause: chain/ contract tests pass: 35 items over the five slots with counts 21/9/4/1 and the 35 store prices; transferring a common, a Tombstone or a badge reverts and transferring a rare succeeds; a node:test confirms the generated module and src/lib/cosmetics.ts name the same 35 visual keys.

units.title: Market contract: list, cancel and buy rare-and-better cosmetics with a 5% fee
units.description: Builds the upgradeable Market (entry 1's upgrade path) that escrows a listed rare-or-better Cosmetics item at a seller-set PETV price (assumption), so the holding ends and entry 8 drops it from the pet, refuses commons, soulbound items and every other token (PetNFT, eggs, Co-Pets), and on buy pays the seller 95%, burns 2.5% through the PETV burn the public burn counter reads and sends 2.5% to PotConverter in the same transaction (AD-11), the 500 bps fee being a timelocked parameter (AD-18), emitting the Listed, Cancelled and Sold events entry 9 indexes.

acceptance.clause: chain/ contract tests pass: listing a common, a Tombstone or a PetNFT reverts; a 10,000 PETV sale pays the seller 9,500, burns 250 and sends 250 to PotConverter; cancel returns the item; a sold or cancelled listing cannot be bought.

units.title: Granted items: season trophy, egg-shard and season skin
units.description: Defines the soulbound (assumption for the skin) season trophy (one id per season), the soulbound egg-shard and the season skin on Cosmetics, each mintable only by a narrow granter role that the timelock gives to the granting contract (EpochDistributor trophies stream, Care streak, SeasonPass), so epic-seasons, epic-play-hub, epic-death-match-raid and epic-store-pass only wire the call (SeasonPass's grant-on-buy hook is epic-store-pass 5.10, whose per-season skin id epic-seasons 10.8 and 10.10 set); it extends epic-pet-life 2.5's per-id soulbound flag and minting roles rather than adding a second mechanism; entry 11 renders the skin id defined here.

acceptance.clause: chain/ contract tests pass: only the role holder can mint each of the three items, a mint by any other address reverts, and every transfer of them reverts.

units.title: Random cosmetic drop at 60/25/12/3 through Randomness
units.description: Adds a commit–reveal drop on the Randomness service (1.16) to Cosmetics that granters (wheel, raid) call: the seed picks a rarity at 6000/2500/1200/300 bps, or the granter's fixed rarity, then an item uniformly within that rarity, with the AD-6 timeout no-op; epic-play-hub wires its prizes to this call.

acceptance.clause: chain/ contract tests pass: the four weights read 6000/2500/1200/300, fixed seeds map to the expected items, 10,000 seeded draws land within ±1.5 points of each share, and a request not revealed in 10 minutes closes as a no-op.

units.title: Shop › Store cosmetics with try-on on the 3D pet
units.description: Builds, from entry 3's item data in the generated chain module, the Store cosmetics grid (cosmetic tile, rarity tag as stars + word, dollar price over PETV) and the try-on card that puts the selected item on the player's own pet on the blob stage over its current loadout, with a separate Buy, the not-enough-PETV shortfall note and the try-on aria-label; the cosmetic tile and rarity tag are the shared components entries 8 and 10 reuse.

acceptance.clause: On the dev app against a local node, tapping any item puts it on the try-on pet with no purchase and no chain call, Buy charges the item's dollar price in PETV and the item then shows as owned, and a player short of PETV sees the gap in dollars instead of a dead button.

units.title: Dress up: equip and unequip in all five slots
units.description: Extends epic-pet-life's equip route (2.10) to all five slots and every pet the player owns (Co-Pet equip comes with epic-social), adds the dress-up sheet on Home using entry 7's cosmetic tile, and, without a schema change, drops an equipped item from the rendered loadout once the holding projection shows the player no longer holds it (sold, listed into entry 4's escrow or transferred).

acceptance.clause: A node:test on the test schema equips one item per slot and reads the five back, equipping an unheld item or another player's pet is refused, and after the item leaves the wallet the pet's loadout no longer includes it.

units.title: Market listings projection and read API
units.description: Indexes Market's Listed, Cancelled and Sold events into a MarketListing projection (writer = indexer) and serves open listings by slot with item, rarity, seller name, PETV price and fee, the response shape entry 10 renders.

acceptance.clause: A worker node:test on the test schema against a local node lists, sells and cancels items and the read API returns exactly the open listings, filtered by slot, with the right seller and price.

units.title: Shop › Market with sell flow and buy review sheet
units.description: Builds Shop › Market from entry 9's API with entry 7's cosmetic tile and rarity tag, PETV prices shown in dollars at the display rate (assumption): rows of rare-and-better items with the slot filter and fee stated up front, a sell flow with a confirm sheet, the buy review sheet (item, seller, dollar price at the display rate, PETV amount, 5% fee, Buy, Not now) with no one-tap buy, and the empty and not-enough-PETV states.

acceptance.clause: On the dev app against a local node one player lists a rare hat, a second player opens it, sees item, seller, dollar price, PETV amount and fee on the review sheet, buys it, and the hat moves to the buyer and leaves the list; tapping a row never buys without the sheet, the slot filter shows only that slot, an empty slot shows the empty state, a player short of PETV sees the gap in dollars, and the sell flow offers no common item.

units.title: Season skin renders on all 10 species
units.description: Using entry 2's fit test, renders entry 5's season skin on every species in baby and adult form on every stage that shows a pet, as a visual layer that leaves the five slots free.
units.unknown: What a season skin is visually (a coat palette, a full-body overlay, or a sixth slot) is not in the spec; recommended: a soulbound per-season coat palette applied over the species' own colours.

acceptance.clause: The fit test from entry 2 passes with the skin on every species and stage, and the owner approves the Gallery contact sheet with the skin on.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Takes the cleanup deferred during the epic, set when it starts from the plans and review findings; scope pushed out of another story is a new story.

acceptance.clause: floor gate passes with no behaviour change: every test from entries 1–11 still passes unchanged.

units.title: Live on 46630: catalogue, granted items, drop and Market
units.description: Upgrades Cosmetics and deploys Market on 46630, grants entry 5's season-skin granter role to the live SeasonPass (5.13), through the Safe-proposed timelock on the governance base (1.15) with Blockscout verification, ships the app to Vercel and the worker to Render, and checks every Done when item on the live contracts.

acceptance.clause: On 46630 a read-only check script confirms 35 items at 21/9/4/1 over five slots and the three granted items with their roles, a common, trophy, egg-shard or skin transfer reverts and a rare transfer succeeds, the drop weights read 6000/2500/1200/300 and one live drop settles, and a test sale shows 2.5% burned and 2.5% at PotConverter; the owner walks Shop › Store try-on and Shop › Market against the mocks.

units.title: Tracer: a Co-Pet invite link hatches a shared egg on 46630
units.description: Delivers the thinnest Co-Pet path through every layer: the inviter creates a 7-day single-use invite (CoPetInvite row, writer = API) from the Home "add" egg, the friend opens the link and accepts, the voucher signer signs a bounded hatchCoPet input, the friend's call makes PetCore mint a new free egg with `coOwner` set (PetCore lets either owner feed, play and enter battles with it), its own pot bucket (AD-4 bucket id), an `ownershipEpoch` that every later ownership change bumps, and an on-chain max-3 Co-Pets check per player; the indexer projects the co-owner and both pet switchers show the Co-Pet chip with the partner's avatar; it adds every Prisma model this epic needs (CoPetInvite, Guild, GuildMember, GuildInvite, GuildJoinRequest, GuildWar, GuildWarMatch) in one migration with a writer per model.

acceptance.clause: On 46630 player A creates an invite, player B opens the link and accepts, and within a minute both switchers show the Co-Pet with the partner's avatar, PetCore shows B as coOwner in a bucket of its own, both A and B can feed it, a fourth Co-Pet hatch for B reverts, and the used link shows "This invite has ended".

units.title: Co-Pet claims pay 50/50 and leave pays the leaver's half first
units.description: Adds the Co-Pet money paths in PetCore: a Co-Pet claim pays ETH owed + pending and accrued Gold half to each owner, and `leaveCoPet(petId)` ("end" is the same call, no price, no payment) runs the AD-17 order in one transaction — touch or bury, settle, leaver's half of unclaimed ETH and Gold to the leaver's pull balance (held by a payoutHold), close the Co-Pet bucket, clear coOwner and bump ownershipEpoch, move the pet (and NFT if the leaver held it) into the remaining owner's bucket, mint the leaver's soulbound memory badge, decrement both counts, emit CoPetLeft for the indexer and entry 5 — and extends epic-pot's randomized invariant test with Co-Pet start, claim and leave steps.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests pass, showing the leaver gets exactly half, the remaining owner's later claim gets the other half, the pet counts in the remaining owner's eff, the memory badge cannot be transferred, no function moves a Co-Pet NFT against payment, and the randomized run with Co-Pet steps keeps the AD-4 balance invariant.

units.title: Two-owner approvals: used once, expire, voided by any ownership change
units.description: Adds the CoPetApprovals contract (UUPS behind the timelock): each owner approves (petId, action, nonce, expiry) for a named action (breed, Death Match entry), a GAME_MODULE consumes the pair once, an approval past its 24-hour expiry or recorded under an older PetCore ownershipEpoch (added in entry 1, bumped by entry 2's leave) is void, a decline is recorded, and request / approve / decline events carry what epic-alerts and the Home card (entry 5) read; epic-growth and epic-death-match-raid call `consume` and build nothing of their own.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show one owner's approval alone cannot be consumed, a pair is consumed once and a replay reverts, an approval after its expiry reverts, and a leave between approval and consume voids it.

units.title: Together bonus and the shared streak
units.description: Adds to PetCore the per-owner last-fed UTC day for a Co-Pet, the Together bonus (once both owners have fed it on the same UTC day, PetCore adds 10% to the points it earns for the rest of that day, additive with the Pass +25%) and the shared streak (consecutive UTC days both fed; a day one owner misses resets it to 0), exposed in views and events for entry 5; it settles in epic-pot's order and raises lifetime points like any other gain (entry 3.3).

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show only one owner feeding gives no bonus and keeps the streak, both feeding the same UTC day gives +10% on later points that day and grows the streak by 1, a missed day resets it, and a solo pet never gets the bonus.

units.title: Home Co-Pet card, invite states, approvals and Leave Co-Pet sheet as in the mocks
units.description: Builds the Home Co-Pet surfaces from entries 1–4: the Co-Pet card (who fed today, Together bonus, shared streak, 50/50 share, "Needs both to agree" with Agree / Decline for a pending request and "Waiting for <partner> to agree"), the invite sheet with pending ("Copy link again", "Cancel invite"), expired and 3-of-3 states, the "Co-Pet options" menu with the Leave Co-Pet confirm sheet, and the memory badge (from entry 2's CoPetLeft projection) in the Profile badge list, which this entry adds if no earlier epic shows badges; the 50/50 share reuses epic-pot's Home pot blob (entry 3.8).

acceptance.clause: Component tests render each state from fixtures, and on a local node two test users see the Together bonus after both feed, one asks for an approval and the other agrees, then one leaves and the pet leaves their switcher while the badge shows in Profile.

units.title: Guild membership API: create, invite, join request, remove, leave
units.description: Adds the off-chain guild routes on the models from entry 1 (writer = API): any player not in a guild starts one and leads it, the leader shares a 7-day invite link and accepts or declines join requests, the leader removes members, a member leaves (a leaving leader passes the lead to the longest-standing member, the last member leaving closes the guild), with at most 10 members, one guild per player, unique names of 3–24 characters, a guild's average level from members' highest living pet and its War eligibility (at least 4 members with a living pet), both of which entry 9 reads, and a near-your-level guild list.

acceptance.clause: API tests on a test_ schema show an 11th join refused, a player in a guild refused by a second guild, a non-leader refused on remove, an expired invite refused, a join request accepted only by the leader, the near-level list ordered by average level, and the lead passing on the leader's leave.

units.title: Guild tab, Guild segment, as in the mock
units.description: Builds the Guild tab and its Guild / War segmented shell (entry 11 fills War), then Guild › Guild on entry 6's routes: the guild card (name, n/10 members, leader, average level), Invite a friend with "Guild is full · 10 of 10", member rows reusing the Battle target row without Attack, leave and remove confirm sheets, join requests for the leader, and the no-guild state with Start a guild, I have a link, and guilds near your level.

acceptance.clause: Component tests render the full, leader, member and no-guild states from fixtures, and a local run shows a second test user joining by link and the leader removing them.

units.title: Battle runs a Guild War 2v2 match from a signed pairing
units.description: Adds a Guild War match kind to epic-battle's Battle module: it takes a GUILD_WAR-signer-signed bounded input (warId, match number, two pets per side, expiry), re-checks both pets are alive and owned or co-owned by the named members, fights with the 2v2 engine and the Randomness service, moves no points, does not count toward the 5-a-day 2v2 limit, and emits GuildWarMatchSettled for the indexer and entry 9; the signed struct defined here is the one entry 9 signs.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a signed match settles once with its result checked against its commitment, an unsigned, expired or replayed input reverts, no pet's points change, and the 2v2 daily count is untouched.

units.title: Worker pairs guilds every Sunday and runs the best-of-5 series
units.description: Adds the Guild War job to the worker: at Sunday 00:00 UTC it freezes each guild's roster that is War-eligible by entry 6's rule, pairs guilds by entry 6's average level (sorted, adjacent pairs, odd one out gets a bye), opens 5 match slots (12:00, 14:00, 16:00, 18:00, 20:00 UTC) whose lineups members pick through an API route until 10 minutes before (each member at most 2 matches, no lineup = forfeit), signs each match as entry 8's struct, projects GuildWarMatchSettled results and closes a series at 3 wins (writers: GuildWar and GuildWarMatch = worker).

acceptance.clause: A worker test on a local node and a test_ schema pairs 5 seeded guilds by average level with one bye, plays a series to 3–1 through entry 8, records a forfeit for an empty lineup, and refuses a third match for one member.

units.title: Guild War Gold prize: weekly guildWar stream paid from the reserve under the daily cap
units.description: Adds a weekly `guildWar` stream to EpochDistributor whose cap is a timelocked weekly Gold allowance, a capped GoldVault payer that the stream's payout hook calls (shares moved from the reserve, never minted, counted in the same daily cap, over-cap Gold left claimable for a later day), and the worker step that, after the series close, posts leaves of the winning guild's frozen roster sharing 5,000 Gold equally, with rosters and results in the public dataset and each member's proof served by epic-pot's dataset route for entry 11's Claim.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a root above the weekly allowance is rejected and a member's claim moves reserve shares without minting and stops at the daily cap, and a worker test on a local node posts a root that entry 3.6's rebuild script reproduces with rosters and results in the dataset.

units.title: Guild tab, War segment, as in the mock
units.description: Builds Guild › War on entries 9 and 10: the War card (opponent, score, your next match and partner, the Gold prize dollars first), the lineup picker, the live board of 5 match chips with words (Won, Lost, Next, Only if needed), the bye and not-eligible states, and the prize claim.

acceptance.clause: Component tests render pre-war, live, won, lost, bye and not-eligible states from fixtures, and a local run of entry 9's seeded series shows the board update after each match and the winners' Claim button.

units.title: Co-Pet and Guild War are live on 46630 and pass a testnet drill
units.description: Upgrades PetCore, Battle, EpochDistributor and GoldVault and deploys CoPetApprovals on 46630 through the Safe and timelock, grants the GUILD_WAR signer and the payout hook, starts the War job on Render, and runs a drill: two real players share a Co-Pet, claim, approve once and leave; two seeded guilds play a War with shortened slots and the winners claim Gold.

acceptance.clause: On 46630 the drill's transactions show the 50/50 claim, the leaver's half and memory badge, a consumed approval and a voided one, a War settled 3–x and a winner's Gold claim within the daily cap, all on verified contracts.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and gate reviews deferred, scope set when it starts; no new behaviour.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes with no behaviour change and every deferred finding is closed or recorded.

units.title: Tracer: a daily wheel spin on a local node lands its prize on the Play hub wheel sheet
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through every layer this epic touches: a Wheel GAME_MODULE that takes one free spin per player per rolling 24h through the Randomness service (AD-6) and pays the full prize table (50% 20 points, 25% one meal to PetCore's food balance, 15% 100 points, 8% random common cosmetic, 2% random rare cosmetic) to the selected pet, its own Ignition module file and generated-chain-module entry, a WheelSpun projection and API route, and the Play hub card registry (one file per activity card in epic-battle 6.11's Play tab shell, which also holds the Dice card, with the Wheel card filled and the other four cards as closed slots that entries 5 and 7 and epic-death-match-raid 15.2 and 15.5 fill) plus the wheel sheet (Spin a real button with aria-busy while spinning; under reduce motion or Calm motion the prize shows directly with no spin), prize card, "Next spin in 23h 59m" state, Home › Spin entry, with the spin's requestId on the prize card for epic-launch's fairness sheet (CAP-28).

acceptance.clause: With app and worker running against a Hardhat local node, a test player taps Spin on the Play hub, sees the revealed prize on the prize card and the Wheel card turn to "Next spin 23h", a second spin inside 24h reverts, under reduced motion the prize shows with no spin animation, and a contract test with fixed seeds pins each prize band of the table.

units.title: PetCore play hooks: lives with care refill, away pets, game Gold and death in Death Match
units.description: Extends PetCore (upgrade-safe, ERC-7201) with the lives and death part of CAP-13, the away part of CAP-19 and the game-Gold part of CAP-20 that entries 4–7 and epic-death-match-raid 15.1–15.5 rely on: lives stored as lives lost so every pet starts with 3, refilled 1 per 7 consecutive good-care windows up to 3 with a TS port and shared vectors; an inDeathMatchRun flag that only DeathMatch (epic-death-match-raid 15.1) sets and clears and Expedition (entry 6) checks; an awayUntil timestamp in the PetCore eligibility view that Battle's settlement re-check (6.3) and MatchArena (6.5) call, adding that call there if missing, so an away pet is refused as attacker, duelist or 2v2 member; a GAME_MODULE awardGold that adds to the unpaid Gold counter epic-petv pays through creditFromGame; and a GAME_MODULE loseLife whose last life runs the AD-16 bury path (Tombstone, free egg, ETH recycle, Gold counter deleted); the battle and expedition counters already in PetCore (epic-pet-life) are incremented by entries 5 and 6 and epic-death-match-raid 15.1 and 15.4.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show a fresh and an upgraded pet both at 3 lives, a life restored after exactly 7 good-care windows and not after 6 or past 3, an away pet refused by Battle at settlement, awarded Gold paid only up to the daily cap with the rest kept, and loseLife at 1 life burning the NFT and minting the Tombstone with the AD-4 invariant intact.

units.title: Play module interfaces, events and read models
units.description: Fixes the shared boundary the lanes build against: the I* interfaces and past-tense events of the Streak (on Care), Monster, Expedition, DeathMatch and Raid modules in chain/contracts/interfaces/, their Prisma projection models (including the Death Match leaderboard and Hall of Fame and raid team invites; random raid partners reuse epic-battle 6.4 MatchQueue with a raid mode added by epic-death-match-raid 15.5) with writer named and one migration, empty indexer handlers named after each event, each new contract's generated-chain-module entry built from the interfaces (lanes then only fill addresses through their own Ignition files), and one usePetAvailability hook (away, dead, in a Death Match run, not adult) from entry 2's PetCore views, wired here into the Play card-registry slot and the Home and Battle action buttons (2.8, 6.9, 6.10) as cooldown-style buttons, with entry 7 adding only the expedition copy, so entries 4–7 and epic-death-match-raid 15.1–15.5 add only their own contract, handler body and screens.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes with the interfaces compiling, the migration applying to a fresh test_ schema, a worker test feeding one synthetic log of each new event to its handler without error, and a hook test reading an away pet as unavailable on a local node.

units.title: Login streak: 10 points on days 1–6, an egg-shard on day 7, reset after a missed day
units.description: Adds a once-per-UTC-day check-in to Care that the app sends on the player's first open of the day, paying 10 points to the selected pet on days 1–6 and minting the soulbound egg-shard on day 7 (then a new 7-day cycle), resetting after a missed UTC day, with the StreakChecked handler and the flame streak chip in the phone top bar and the "Day 4 streak" pill in the desktop top nav.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests with time travel pin 10 points on days 1–6, one egg-shard on day 7, a reset to day 1 after a skipped UTC day and a second check-in the same day reverting; a UI test on a local node shows the chip read "Day 2 streak" after two days.

units.title: Monsters: three fights a day scaled to the pet's level, each win pays Gold and 20 points
units.description: Adds the Monster GAME_MODULE on epic-battle's fight engine and the Randomness service: 3 fights per pet per UTC day against a monster at the pet's level (assumed stats in Notes), a win awarding 20 points and Gold through entry 2's awardGold and counting a battle action, a loss costing nothing, an away or dead pet refused; plus its handler, the Monsters card ("2 of 3 left today"), the self-playing fight with Skip to result on epic-battle's fight view, and the prize card carrying the fight's requestId for epic-launch's fairness sheet.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests pin 3 fights a day, a 4th reverting, 20 points and the assumed Gold per win paid under the cap, and an away pet refused; on a local node a test player fights a monster from the Play hub and sees the card count drop and the prize card show Gold and points.

units.title: Expedition module: Safe and Bold trips of 1, 8 or 24 hours
units.description: Adds the Expedition GAME_MODULE: one trip per pet at a time, refused while entry 2's inDeathMatchRun flag is set, setting entry 2's awayUntil and counting an expedition action; Safe pays 10 / 40 / 100 points on return; Bold escrows a PETV stake within the assumed bounds, takes its 30% fail roll from a commitment revealed at send (no recall exists, so the early reveal changes nothing), and on return pays 3× the Safe points and returns the stake, or burns the stake emitting Burned as a registered burn source.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests pin the three durations and Safe rewards, a Bold success returning the stake with 3× points, a Bold fail burning exactly the stake with one Burned event, a fixed-seed run giving a 30% fail band, a reveal timeout refunding the stake, no battle or second trip while away, and a send refused for a pet in a Death Match run.

units.title: Expeditions card, send sheet, Bold danger confirm, away state and return prize card
units.description: Builds the Expeditions card (Safe / Bold, 1h / 8h / 24h, "Back in 3h 12m" progress bar), the Bold stake picker with the danger note and confirm sheet and the Not-enough-PETV shortfall note, the "Mochi is away · back in 3h 12m" copy on the buttons entry 3 already turns into cooldown buttons, and the return prize card or "The expedition failed. Your 500 PETV stake was burned." with the burn counter tick, from entry 6's handler.

acceptance.clause: On a local node a test player sends a Safe 1h trip and a Bold trip with time travel, sees battle buttons show the wait while away, and gets the Safe prize card and a Bold success or fail card whose amounts equal the contract's events.

units.title: Play hub live on 46630: modules deployed, roles granted, every activity checked
units.description: After the owner OKs each deploy (CLAUDE.md) and the Safe signers sign, deploys and verifies Wheel, Monster and Expedition and upgrades PetCore (with every play hook entry 2 adds, which epic-death-match-raid 15.6 builds on), Care, and Battle and MatchArena with entry 2's awayUntil check on 46630 through Safe-proposed timelocked actions (GAME_MODULE, Cosmetics minter and burn-source wiring), regenerates the chain module, ships app and worker to Vercel and Render, and runs each activity once live; DeathMatch and Raid go live in epic-death-match-raid 15.6.
units.unknown: Does the owner accept the assumed play-hub numbers in epic-play-hub.md Notes (monster stats and Gold, Bold stake bounds; the Death Match and raid numbers moved with epic-death-match-raid) before they go live?

acceptance.clause: Tx hashes on 46630 show the timelocked deploys, upgrades and role grants with Blockscout-verified source, and a test player on the Vercel app spins, checks in, fights a monster, returns from a Bold trip, and an away pet is refused by Battle and MatchArena, each result matching its commitment.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Death Match module: weekend window, 3 lives, survivor streak, safe leave
units.description: Adds the DeathMatch GAME_MODULE on epic-battle's fight engine: entry only Saturday 00:00 – Sunday 23:59:59 UTC for an awake, not-away pet of level 6+ with lives left, one run per pet per weekend and at most 20 fights per pet per weekend (DECISIONS #57, a timelocked parameter), with epic-play-hub 9.2's inDeathMatchRun set on entry and cleared on leave, death or close, a Co-Pet only with both owners' epic-social approvals (used once); each win against another entered pet within ±2 levels adds 1 to the streak and awards 2× the ranked duel points × the streak (max 5×), each loss calls epic-play-hub 9.2's loseLife (0 lives = death); leave is allowed between fights at any time and keeps the points, and the keeper closes open runs as safe exits after the window.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests pin the window edges (Friday 23:59:59 refused, Saturday 00:00 open, Monday 00:00 refused), adult-only entry, the reward ladder 2×/4×/6×/8×/10× capped at 5×, a loss at 1 life burying the pet, a safe leave keeping points, a Co-Pet refused with one approval and accepted with two, a 21st fight in one weekend refused, and a reveal timeout leaving lives and streak unchanged.

units.title: Death Match card, entry warning with type-the-name confirm, run and "Leave safely?"
units.description: Builds the Death Match card (3 lives, "Your pet can pass away at 0 lives.", "Leave safely any time.", "Opens in 2d 6h" closed state, adults-only and "Waiting for Ria" Co-Pet states), the entry warning sheet that enables Enter only after the pet's name is typed, the run screen (hearts, streak, next multiplier, fight log, always-visible "Leave now and keep rewards"), the last-life "Leave safely?" sheet that never times out, and "Mochi passed away." leading to the Tombstone, from entry 1's handler.

acceptance.clause: On a local node with the clock at Saturday a test player enters only after typing the pet's name, wins, loses to 1 life and is stopped by the "Leave safely?" sheet, leaves and sees the kept points; an accessibility test shows focus on each sheet title and that the sheet never closes on a timer.

units.title: Death Match weekend leaderboard, Hall of Fame data and the desktop lobby
units.description: Adds the weekend leaderboard and per-season Hall of Fame (best streaks of pets that left safely) as projections and one public API route that epic-seasons' Season page reuses, plus the desktop lobby (choose a pet, reward ladder, time left, leaderboard, Hall of Fame) and the phone leaderboard / Hall of Fame view.

acceptance.clause: A worker and API test on a local node with three scripted runs returns the leaderboard by points and a Hall of Fame holding only the safe exit, and the lobby renders them at 1280px with the reward ladder computed from the contract's parameters.

units.title: Boss Raid module: a season boss whose health is shared by every raid
units.description: Adds the Raid GAME_MODULE on epic-battle's fight engine: one boss per season (from SeasonPass.seasonOf) with the assumed health, teams of 1 or 2 formed on-chain when the invited partner joins, one raid per pet per UTC day, damage from the fight lowering the shared health and awarding points and Gold per pet through epic-play-hub 9.2's awardGold, raids closed once health reaches 0 until the next season, and per-season team damage totals readable for the trophies stream.

acceptance.clause: Contract tests show two teams' raids lowering one shared health total, points and Gold per damage at the assumed rates, a second raid the same day reverting, a raid after health 0 refused, and team totals reset at a new season.

units.title: Boss Raid card, partner finding, raid fight and top-team results for the trophies stream
units.description: Builds the Boss Raid card ("Team of 2", "Season boss 62%" progress bar, "you dealt 1,240 damage"), invite-a-friend and "Finding a match…" random-partner pairing (a raid mode on epic-battle 6.4 MatchQueue, on-chain join) with "Stop looking" and the Empty state when no partner comes (card stays on "Find a partner", nothing spent) and the Error state when a raid fails to start, the self-playing raid fight and reward card, and a tested worker function that ranks the season's top raid teams into trophies-stream leaves naming the raid prize item (a Raid parameter, assumed in Notes), which epic-seasons' trophies epoch builder includes.

acceptance.clause: On a local node two test players pair, raid and both see the shared boss bar drop and their reward card, a lone searcher who stops looking sees the Empty state with nothing spent, a failed raid shows the Error state, and a worker test turns a scripted season's raids into top-team leaves whose order and item id match the contract's team totals.

units.title: Death Match and Boss Raid live on 46630: modules deployed, roles granted, both events checked
units.description: After the owner OKs each deploy (CLAUDE.md) and the Safe signers sign, deploys and verifies DeathMatch and Raid on 46630 on top of epic-play-hub 9.13's live PetCore play upgrade through Safe-proposed timelocked actions (GAME_MODULE, the Randomness consumer role and the CoPetApprovals consumer role for DeathMatch), regenerates the chain module, ships the app and worker to Vercel and Render, and runs a Death Match on a shortened-window test parameter and one Boss Raid live.
notes: hitl steps: the owner OKs every deploy to 46630 (CLAUDE.md); two Safe signers sign the role grants; the owner sets and later restores the shortened Death Match window; two test players run the raid.
units.unknown: Does the owner accept the assumed Death Match and Boss Raid numbers in epic-death-match-raid.md Notes (window, boss health, damage reward rates, raid prize item) before they go live?

acceptance.clause: On the Vercel production app against 46630 a test pet enters a Death Match in the shortened window, wins, loses a life and leaves safely onto the leaderboard and Hall of Fame route, a Co-Pet is refused with one approval and enters with two, two test players raid the season boss and see the shared health drop, and DeathMatch and Raid show verified source on Blockscout.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Tracer: a ranked duel puts a pet on the Season card, and a season boundary resets it
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through every layer the epic touches: the indexer writes a SeasonRank projection (writer = indexer) keyed by chainId, season and petId from epic-battle 6.2's ranked-duel event (which must carry the season and the new rank; MatchArena already keys rank by SeasonPass.seasonOf, so a new season starts at 1,000), one seasonStandings(season, block) function orders pets by rank (ties: earlier reach, then lower petId) for entries 2, 3 and 5 to reuse, a /api/season route returns season number, weeks left and the player's best pet's position, and a bare Play › Season card shows "Week N of 12" and "Your rank #N".

acceptance.clause: On the Hardhat local node with a 1-hour test season, two ranked duels move a pet to #1 on the Season card, and after the boundary passes the card shows season 2, MatchArena's rank view for the pet reads 1,000, and the projection rebuilt from the deploy block matches.

units.title: Season-end job posts the season-pool bonus root
units.description: Adds the season-end job to the worker and the seasonPool payer path: after the season's end plus confirmations and once the indexer passes the snapshot block, it takes the top pets from entry 1's seasonStandings, excludes flagged and held pets via epic-pot's exclusion list, splits the PETV that epic-store-pass 5.10 sends to the seasonPool stream (20% of Pass income) by the owner's bonus split, stores Epoch and EpochLeaf rows, posts (seasonPool, season, root, datasetHash, total) with EPOCH_POSTER under the funded cap, and adds the PETV payout hook for the seasonPool stream (set through the timelock in entry 9) so the bonus never touches the ETH pot.
units.unknown: How many top pets share the season-pool bonus, and in what split?

acceptance.clause: A worker and contract test on a local node with a seasonPool stream funded by a Pass buy posts one root at the shortened season end, the epic-pot rebuild script reproduces it from the public route, a top pet's owner claims the bonus in PETV after the delay, and PetCore's ETH pot balance is unchanged.

units.title: Season-end job posts the trophies root: top 10% and top raid teams
units.description: Extends entry 2's season-end job with the trophies stream: leaves for the top 10% (rounded up) of pets with at least one ranked duel that season by seasonStandings, flagged and held pets excluded as in entry 2, plus the top raid teams' leaves from epic-death-match-raid 15.5's top-team leaf function, posted as one trophies root per season, with claims minting the season's soulbound trophy (epic-cosmetics-market 7.5) and the raid prize through the trophies payout hook.

acceptance.clause: A worker and contract test on a local node with 20 ranked pets and two raid teams posts one trophies root holding exactly 2 trophy leaves and the raid leaves, a winner claims a trophy that then refuses to transfer, and the dataset rebuilds the same root.

units.title: SeasonRewards: the Season Pass reward track pays during the season
units.description: Adds an upgradeable SeasonRewards module behind the timelock with 12 weekly nodes per season whose contents (points through PetCore, cosmetics through Cosmetics) are timelocked parameters, letting an active Pass holder (SeasonPass.isActive) claim node w once week w of the current season has started, once per address, with the final node showing the season skin that epic-store-pass grants at purchase, plus the Ignition wiring that proposes its PetCore points role and Cosmetics granter role through the timelock (entry 9 executes them on 46630).
units.unknown: What do reward-track nodes 1 to 11 pay (points, PETV or which cosmetics)?

acceptance.clause: Contract tests on Hardhat show a Pass holder claiming week 1 and week 2 nodes only after each week starts and only once, a non-holder refused, contents changeable only through the timelock, and a new season's nodes opening fresh.

units.title: Season page with leaderboard, season pool and Hall of Fame
units.description: Grows the tracer's card into the spine's Season card and page reached from Play › Season and a new Season row in epic-pot's Avatar menu: weeks left, the player's rank row first, the top 100 from seasonStandings in the target-row look, "Top players share the season pool (not the ETH pot)" with the stream balance dollars first, "Ranks reset when the season ends", and Leaderboard / Hall of Fame segments reading epic-death-match-raid 15.3's public Hall of Fame route, with empty, loading, error and offline states.

acceptance.clause: A component and route test on a local node shows a player's rank row above the top 100, the season pool amount equal to the EpochDistributor seasonPool view, the "Ranks reset" line, Hall of Fame rows for a seeded Death Match from the 15.3 route, each of the empty, loading, error and offline states, and the segmented tabs working by keyboard.

units.title: Reward track on Shop › Pass
units.description: Adds the reward track to epic-store-pass's Shop › Pass card: nodes fill as the season's weeks pass, an open node is claimed through SeasonRewards from entry 4, claimed nodes show done, the final node shows the season skin, and a player without the Pass sees the track locked with the buy button.

acceptance.clause: A component test on a local node shows a Pass holder in week 3 with nodes 1–3 open, claiming node 2 once moves it to done on the next read, and a non-holder sees every node locked.

units.title: Season bonus and trophy in Claims
units.description: Adds the seasonPool and trophies payouts to epic-pot's Avatar menu › Claims list (proof from the public dataset route, claimed on EpochDistributor, the PETV bonus dollars first through the display-rate service) and the indexer handlers that write their claims to the Claim projection.

acceptance.clause: A server and worker test on a local node shows a pet in posted seasonPool and trophies roots listed in Claims, each claimed once through the list, and both claims written once to the Claim projection after a worker restart.

units.title: Season rollover runs once per boundary and readies the next season
units.description: Makes the season boundary repeatable: the worker runs entries 2 and 3 once per season and resumes safely after a restart, an admin script proposes through the Safe and timelock the next season's trophy and season-skin item ids and reward-track contents before the boundary, and a runbook says what the operator checks after each rollover.

acceptance.clause: On the Hardhat local node with 1-hour test seasons, two boundaries in a row each post exactly one seasonPool and one trophies root even with a worker restart mid-job, season 2's trophy id differs from season 1's, and the Season card shows season 3 with ranks reset.

units.title: Shortened-season drill on 46630
units.description: Deploys SeasonRewards through a Safe-proposed timelocked deploy on 46630 with Blockscout verification and a regenerated chain module, executes the timelocked grants (SeasonRewards' PetCore and Cosmetics roles, the seasonPool PETV payout hook), runs entries 2, 3 and 8 on the Render worker against a shortened-season test deploy, and checks a full season end in the deployed app.

acceptance.clause: On 46630 with a 1-hour test season, the boundary posts seasonPool and trophies roots that the rebuild script reproduces from the Vercel route, a test player claims the bonus (not from the ETH pot) and a trophy that refuses to transfer, claims a reward-track node, and the Season page shows the new season with ranks reset.

units.title: Season 1 starts on the live testnet deploy
units.description: Starts season 1 on the live 46630 deploy once the owner confirms its date (recommended Sunday 2027-01-03 00:00 UTC, or the first Sunday 00:00 UTC after testnet opens if later): if epic-store-pass 5.13's SeasonPass genesis differs, entry 8's admin script proposes the change through the Safe and timelock, aligns the EpochDistributor seasonPool and trophies genesis and 12-week length with it, and registers season 1's trophy, skin and reward-track contents.

acceptance.clause: Public views on 46630 show SeasonPass.seasonOf(genesis) = 1, the seasonPool and trophies streams with the same genesis and a 12-week epoch, season 1's items registered, and the deployed Season card reading "Week 1 of 12" after the start.

units.title: Refactor sweep
units.description: Cleans up what the epic's plans and deferred review findings list, with scope set when it starts; cleanup only, any pushed-out scope is a new entry.

acceptance.clause: The gate passes and every deferred finding recorded in this epic's plans is closed or moved to a named entry.

units.title: Tracer: a pet's Teen path and stage from chain to the Home badge and 3D stage
units.description: Delivers the thinnest path through every layer the epic touches: a PetCore upgrade that fixes the path (Warrior, Guardian or Explorer from the battle, care and expedition counters, ties to Guardian then Warrior) in the same call that first takes the pet to level 3, with pets already past level 3 getting theirs on their next touch; a new upgradeable Evolution module whose stageOf view returns Baby, Teen (level 3) or Adult (level 6) from level, with the stage levels as timelocked parameters (AD-18) that a drill may lower and restore; the Ignition module, Blockscout verification and generated chain module for both; the indexer projecting PathSet and the stage into the Pet table; and Home showing "Bunny · Lv 6 · Adult" with the Warrior / Guardian / Explorer path and the existing baby or adult 3D form chosen by stage, a mapping entry 4 replaces with a stage prop.

acceptance.clause: On 46630, with the Teen and Adult levels lowered for the drill through the Safe and timelock and restored after, a test pet fed and fought past each level shows on the Vercel Home badge as Teen with its path and then Adult in the adult 3D form within a minute of each level-up, and the PathSet event and stageOf view on Blockscout agree with it.

units.title: Breeding module: eligibility, doubling cost, commit-reveal egg with inherited traits and 1 in 500 shiny
units.description: Delivers CAP-17's on-chain rules as an upgradeable Breeding module tested on Hardhat's in-process network: two awake parents at level 6+ with good care in the current 24-hour window, each the caller's own pet or a Co-Pet the caller co-owns with its partner's one-use on-chain approval (AD-17), at most 5 breeds per parent and a 24-hour cooldown per parent, cost $2.99 × 2^(the higher parent's breed count) in PETV through the price source and the Store's egg payment split, then a Randomness request whose settle mints an egg to the caller with species and element 45% parent A / 45% parent B / 10% any, a random coat of that species and shiny when seed mod 500 = 0, a timeout no-op that refunds the PETV, leaves counts and cooldowns unchanged and emits BreedRefunded, and a pure TS breedOutcome(seed, parents) port the contract matches by shared vectors, which entry 10 and epic-launch's "Check this result" also use; any PetCore hook it needs (egg mint with given traits, care-window view) builds on entry 1's PetCore upgrade.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show a valid breed mints the predicted egg from the revealed seed (matching breedOutcome), refusals for a non-adult, a pet without good care, a 6th breed, a parent in cooldown, a stranger's pet and a Co-Pet without its partner's approval, costs of 1×, 2×, 4×, 8×, 16× $2.99, a timed-out request refunding in full, and between 150 and 250 shiny eggs in a seeded breedOutcome run of 100,000 seeds.

units.title: Evolution to Elder and Mythic with their items and the trophy check
units.description: Extends entry 1's Evolution module with evolve(petId) for an awake pet: Elder needs level 15 and burns one soulbound Elder item from the caller, Mythic needs Elder, level 30, burns one Mythic item and needs the caller (either owner of a Co-Pet) to hold a season trophy of any season, named by its token id and checked against the per-season trophy ids (top-10% finish, not raid cosmetics) that epic-cosmetics-market defines and epic-seasons 10.8 registers each season, minted by 10.3, which is not used up; the Elder and Mythic items are new soulbound ids in the Cosmetics ERC-1155 that the Store mints on purchase ($3 and $5), and stageOf now returns Elder and Mythic; the Elder and Mythic levels are timelocked parameters like entry 1's.

acceptance.clause: The chain/ contract tests show Elder and Mythic succeed only for an awake pet with level, item and (Mythic) a season trophy in place, a raid cosmetic does not count as a trophy, each burns exactly one item, a failed evolve keeps the item, the items cannot be transferred, and stageOf returns the new stage.

units.title: 3D looks for Teen, Elder, Mythic, the five elements and shiny
units.description: Gives PetModel a stage prop in place of entry 1's baby-or-adult mapping and adds, without changing any species' geometry, a Teen form between baby and adult proportions, Elder and Mythic accents on the adult form, an element accent for fire, water, leaf, spark and stone on top of the random coat, and a shiny finish, with every combination shown on the existing Gallery page.

acceptance.clause: A render test mounts every species at every stage with every element, shiny and not, with no error, and the owner approves the looks on the Gallery page.

units.title: Breeding, Evolution v2 and any PetCore hooks deployed and verified on 46630 with the items on sale
units.description: Adds Breeding, the Evolution upgrade and any PetCore upgrade entry 2 needed to the Ignition module, deploys them to 46630 through the Safe and 1-hour timelock (Breeding granted GAME_MODULE and its Randomness consumer role, Evolution granted the burner role for the Elder and Mythic ids on Cosmetics, the Store granted the minter role for those two ids, the Elder and Mythic items registered in the Store at $3 and $5, the egg payment split reused for breeding), verifies both on Blockscout and regenerates the chain module.

acceptance.clause: On 46630, every deployed or upgraded contract shows verified source on Blockscout, the timelock's executed operations show the role grants and Store items, and a script buys an Elder item through the Store and reads a breed quote of $2.99 in PETV.

units.title: Indexer projections and the pet growth read for evolution and breeding
units.description: Extends the indexer with Evolved, BreedRequested, BreedSettled and BreedRefunded into the Pet table (stage, path, element, shiny, parent ids, breeds used, cooldown end) and adds the read that the Evolve and Breed sheets use: next stage and what it needs, owned item counts, eligible partners among the player's own pets and Co-Pets, breeds left and the next breed's dollar cost read from contract views (AD-18).

acceptance.clause: Worker and API tests on the Hardhat local-node fixture evolve one pet, breed two and let one breed time out, then show the projected rows and the read's next stage, breeds left, eligible partners and next cost matching the contract views, with a restart mid-sync leaving no duplicate rows.

units.title: Evolve button and Evolve sheet on the Home pet card
units.description: Adds the Evolve and Breed button pair to the Home pet card (Breed shown locked with its reason until entry 8) and the Evolve sheet per the spine: locked reasons ("Evolve at Lv 15", "Evolve at Lv 30 + season trophy"), "Evolve · needs Elder item $3" opening the Store on that item, before → after 3D preview, path line, item ticked, dollars-first cost, the shortfall note, a confirm, the new look and badge after success, and "Couldn't evolve Mochi. Try again. Your item is safe." on failure; it also wires the Home blob stage's PetModel to the read's stage, element and shiny so every pet shows entry 4's look.

acceptance.clause: Component tests on the read's fixtures show each locked, needs-item, ready and failure state with its exact copy and focusable locked buttons, and on the Vercel preview, with the Elder level lowered for the drill, a test pet buys an Elder item from the Store sheet, evolves, its badge reads "· Elder" and the stage shows its element and Elder look.

units.title: Breed sheet on the Home pet card
units.description: Opens the Breed button from entry 7 and adds the Breed sheet per the spine: locked reasons ("Breed at Adult", "No breeds left · 5 of 5 used", "Mochi needs good care to breed", cooldown time left), a partner picker of eligible adults among own pets and Co-Pets, egg preview, "Breed 1 of 5 · each breed costs double the last", dollars-first cost, "1 in 500 eggs is shiny", the shortfall note, a confirm, the Co-Pet "Waiting for Priya to agree" state through epic-social's approval request, and the new egg in the pet switcher once the breed settles.

acceptance.clause: Component tests on the read's fixtures show each locked, waiting-for-partner, shortfall and ready state with its exact copy, and on the Vercel preview breeding two adult test pets puts a new egg in the pet switcher within a minute.
